title: AI Agent Developer
description:
About the role We are looking for a hands-on AI Agent Developer to build, integrate and support AI agents that execute defined business workflows. Working closely with the AI Architect and Product Owner, this person will translate workflow requirements and approved architecture into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions, taking agents from prototype through testing, production deployment and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities Workflow implementation. Work with the Product Owner to understand business processes, user needs, exceptions and acceptance criteria. Translate these into agent logic, workflow steps and technical implementation tasks, aligned with the AI Architect s design. Agent development and orchestration. Build agents using prompts, tool calling and workflow orchestration. Implement state management, routing, validation, retries, timeouts and fallback paths, including human review and approval where required. Develop connectors and tools to interact with enterprise applications and APIs. RAG and enterprise knowledge. Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval and grounded responses with source citations where needed. Apply source access permissions and support updates to keep agent knowledge current. Testing and evaluation. Create automated tests and representative evaluation scenarios covering normal workflows, exceptions and misuse. Measure response quality, task completion, tool execution accuracy, latency and cost against agreed acceptance criteria. Security and responsible use. Implement controls defined by the AI Architect and security teams, including least-privilege access, sensitive-data protection, prompt-injection defenses, audit trails and human approval before consequential actions. Deployment and production support. Package and deploy agents through approved delivery pipelines. Implement logging, tracing and monitoring; investigate failures and support incident resolution, version management and rollback. Continuous improvement and documentation. Improve agent reliability, performance and cost based on evaluations and user feedback. Maintain code, tool contracts, configuration, technical documentation and support runbooks. Required experience and skills Software development. Strong hands-on development skills in Python or TypeScript, with experience building maintainable applications using version control, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. LLMs and agent development. Practical experience building tool-enabled AI agents, including prompting, structured outputs, context management and orchestration. Understanding of model limitations, unreliable outputs and agent failure modes. Workflow engineering. Ability to translate business workflows into executable logic, including conditional paths, approval steps, exception handling and recovery. Ability to identify where deterministic rules should support agent behavior. APIs and integration. Experience with REST APIs, authentication methods such as OAuth, SQL/NoSQL databases and asynchronous processing. Ability to build reliable integrations with existing enterprise systems. Evaluation and troubleshooting. Ability to build test datasets, evaluate end-to-end agent behavior and diagnose issues across prompts, retrieval, tools and integrations. Collaboration and delivery. Ability to work closely with AI Architects, Product Owners and business stakeholders, communicate implementation constraints and deliver iteratively in a fast-paced environment Preferred experience Knowledge of HR processes and enterprise HR platforms such as Workday, including employee-data access, workflow integration and approval boundaries. Experience with enterprise agent platforms, orchestration frameworks, cloud services and AI evaluation or observability tools.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own a program of concurrent customer engineering projects - typically 3-7 projects across test measurement, embedded, software and AI engagements for global customers. You will be the single point of accountability for program health: delivery against commitments, margin, leading teams, risk, and customer satisfaction. You will work through Project Leads and Architects, step in where a project needs it, and give leadership a clear, honest view of where every engagement stands. You bring strong engineering judgment and the discipline to run many moving parts at once - keeping every project healthy. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you! Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to manage 3-7 concurrent customer engineering projects across test measurement, embedded, software and AI domains. The role involves end-to-end program delivery, governance, resource planning, risk management, financial performance and customer satisfaction. You will lead through Project Leads and Architects, manage senior customer relationships, ensure delivery excellence and drive continuous improvement across the program. Responsibilities Program governance: Own end-to-end delivery of a program of 3-7 concurrent projects (fixed-bid and TM), from kickoff to closure. Program governance: Set up a governance cadence: weekly program reviews, RAG status, milestone and burn tracking, and monthly reviews with leadership. Program governance: Track program-level metrics - schedule and effort variance, gross margin, utilization, quality, and customer satisfaction - and act on trends. Planning, people and risk: Build integrated plans across projects, including cross-project dependencies, shared components and shared lab/hardware resources. Planning, people and risk: Partner with People Management on ramp-ups, ramp-downs and people movement across the program. Planning, people and risk: Maintain a program risk and issue register; drive mitigations with Project Leads before they become escalations. Planning, people and risk: Review estimates, SOWs and change requests with Architects to keep scope, cost and timelines realistic. Customer and stakeholder management: Act as the senior delivery contact for customer program managers and engineering leaders, often across US/EU time zones. Customer and stakeholder management: Run steering-committee and QBR-style reviews; communicate status, risks and decisions clearly and honestly. Customer and stakeholder management: Identify account growth opportunities (follow-on phases, new workstreams) and support Sales and Pre-sales with proposals. Execution excellence and people: Mentor Project Leads and Senior Engineers on planning, estimation, customer communication and Agile/hybrid delivery. Execution excellence and people: Ensure engineering practices are followed - code reviews, CI/CD, test strategy, documentation, and compliance where applicable. Execution excellence and people: Standardise tools, templates and reporting across the program, and drive retrospectives and continuous improvement. Execution excellence and people: Handle project recovery: step into troubled projects, diagnose root causes and put them back on track. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering (CS, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation or related). 7-12 years of experience, starting in hands-on engineering, with 3+ years managing multiple projects or a program at the same time. Proven delivery of customer-facing projects in a services or product-engineering setting, with ownership of both schedule and financials (budget, margin, billing). Strong technical depth in at least one area - software (C#/.NET, Python, full stack), embedded/FPGA, or test measurement automation - enough to challenge estimates and architecture decisions. Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and hybrid delivery models, and when to use each. Hands-on with program tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps, MS Project or equivalent, and program dashboards. Excellent written and spoken communication; comfortable presenting to customer executives and internal leadership. Track record of growing and mentoring Project Leads. Good to have Skills Exposure to hardware-software projects - test systems, lab setups, data acquisition, or embedded products. Experience delivering GenAI, AI/ML or data projects for customers. Experience working with US/European customers, including on-site visits. Work Location: Coimbatore/Bangalore. This role will require working from the office (WFO) for the first 12 months.

Job Summary Job Title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer Position: Lead Experience: 8+ Years Category: Software Development/ Engineering Main location: Bangalore Employment Type: Full Time Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience. Position Description: We are looking for a Full Stack AI Engineer with 8+ years of experience in designing and building scalable enterprise applications. The role requires strong expertise across backend engineering with .NET, modern frontend development, Azure cloud services, and AI-powered solutions including LLM integrations, RAG, and agentic workflows. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who can drive solution design, build production-grade systems, and guide teams on engineering best practices, security, and scalability. Key Responsibilities Design and develop scalable full stack applications using C#, .NET 8/9+, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and Entity Framework. Build responsive frontend applications using React or Angular, along with TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Design, develop, and deploy cloud-native applications on Azure, preferably using Azure Functions, App Service, Key Vault, and Storage. Build and integrate AI/LLM-powered solutions using Azure OpenAI or OpenAI APIs, including prompt engineering and embeddings. Develop agentic AI solutions with tool/function calling, memory, multi-agent workflows, and orchestration patterns. Implement RAG architectures using Azure AI Search or vector databases, including document ingestion, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and response grounding. Work with AI frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, and where appropriate LangChain or LangGraph. Integrate enterprise applications and platforms using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, and distributed systems design. Establish and support CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps or GitHub and Docker. Ensure solutions are secure by design using OAuth2, OIDC, Entra ID, API security, and Responsible AI practices. Drive architecture decisions around microservices, observability, resilience, scalability, and maintainability. Mentor engineers, review code and design, and contribute to technical standards and best practices. Requirements 8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong exposure to enterprise application development. Strong hands-on experience in C#, .NET 8/9+, ASP.NET Core, Web API, and Entity Framework. Solid frontend development experience using React or Angular and TypeScript. Strong cloud experience with Microsoft Azure, especially Azure Functions, App Service, Key Vault, and Storage. Experience integrating and deploying LLM-based applications using Azure OpenAI/OpenAI APIs. Strong understanding of RAG pipelines, vector search, document chunking, embeddings, and retrieval strategies. Experience building AI agents with tool/function calling, orchestration, and memory concepts. Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. Strong knowledge of REST APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven integration patterns. Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and modern DevOps practices. Strong understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, Entra ID, API security, and secure application design. Experience designing microservices-based or scalable cloud-native architectures. Good knowledge of observability, logging, monitoring, and production support practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other LLM orchestration frameworks. Experience with Azure AI Search, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge ingestion pipelines. Exposure to multi-agent systems and advanced workflow orchestration. Experience in enterprise modernization or legacy-to-cloud transformation. Familiarity with Responsible AI goverce and AI application evaluation frameworks. Experience leading small technical teams or acting as a technical lead. Strong problem-solving and system design skills. Able to work across business, product, architecture, and engineering teams. Comfortable owning solutions end-to-end, from design to production deployment. Able to balance hands-on development with technical leadership. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. title: Senior React UI Developer (Looking For Immediate Joiners)
description:
Job Description: Senior React UI Developer Optimizely CMS, Node.js & Redis Position Summary We are seeking a Senior React UI Developer with 8+ years of total IT experience and at least 4 years of hands-on React.js experience . This is primarily a UI/frontend development role. The ideal candidate will build responsive, accessible, and high-performing user interfaces, integrate React applications with Optimizely CMS(preferred) , and have working knowledge of Node.js and Redis to support frontend integrations, caching, local development, and troubleshooting. 
 Required Experience UX 8+ years of total software development experience. 4+ years of hands-on React.js development experience. Experience integrating UI applications with Optimizely CMS . Working experience with Node.js in a frontend ecosystem. Experience using Redis for caching and performance optimization. Key Responsibilities Design and develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components using React.js. Develop responsive web interfaces using TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Sass. Convert UX designs and wireframes into pixel-accurate user interfaces. Integrate React UI components with Optimizely CMS content and APIs. Render Optimizely pages, blocks, content types, and personalized content in the UI. Work with CMS and backend teams to define API contracts and content models. Consume REST, GraphQL, Optimizely Graph, or Content Delivery APIs. Use Node.js-based frontend tooling, package management, build scripts, and middleware or BFF integrations where required. Work with Redis-backed caching for CMS content and API responses. Coordinate with backend teams on cache keys, TTLs, invalidation, and content-refresh behavior. Ensure Optimizely content updates are reflected correctly in the UI. Implement client-side state management using Redux Toolkit, Context API, or similar libraries. Optimize UI performance, including bundle size, lazy loading, code splitting, image loading, and rendering. Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility. Write unit, component, integration, and end-to-end tests. Participate in technical design discussions and Agile ceremonies. Troubleshoot UI, CMS integration, API, caching, and production issues. Mandatory Technical Skills Strong hands-on expertise in: React.js, functional components, hooks, and component lifecycle JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript HTML5, CSS3, Sass, and responsive web design State management using Redux Toolkit, Context API, or equivalent RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL Optimizely CMS/Episerver UI integration Node.js-based frontend development and build tooling Redis cache integration and troubleshooting Strong understanding of: Component-driven UI architecture Responsive and mobile-first design Browser rendering and frontend performance Cross-browser compatibility Error handling and API integration patterns Experience with: Jest and React Testing Library Cypress or Playwright Git-based development workflows npm or Yarn Vite, Webpack, or similar build tools Optimizely CMS Skills Experience consuming content from Optimizely CMS. Understanding of pages, blocks, content types, content models, and templates. Experience with Optimizely Graph, Content Delivery API, REST, or GraphQL integration. Familiarity with preview, publishing, personalization, and content workflows. Ability to collaborate with CMS developers and content authors. Node.js and Redis Expectations This is not a backend or full-stack role . The candidate is not expected to own backend application development. Relevant Node.js and Redis experience should include: Using Node.js for frontend tooling, build scripts, package management, SSR support, or lightweight middleware. Understanding how the UI and CMS integrations consume Redis-cached API responses. Ability to troubleshoot stale content and caching-related UI issues. Familiarity with cache keys, TTLs, cache invalidation, and fallback behavior. Collaboration with backend/platform teams on Redis configuration and caching strategies. Preferred Skills Experience with Next.js, server-side rendering, or static-site generation. Familiarity with Optimizely Content Cloud, Optimizely Graph, experimentation, and personalization. Exposure to Azure Cache for Redis, Amazon ElastiCache, or Redis Cloud. Experience with design systems or component libraries such as shadcn, Tailwind css. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

title: Principal Software Architect- Distributed Systems & Cloud Platforms
description:
Job Summary Principal Software Architect Years of Experience: 10-15 Years Location: Bangalore, client location (5 days in the office) Role Overview We are looking for an experienced software/system architect to own the end-to-end design of a complex,large-scale distributed software platform. The role involves translating business and functional requirements into system architecture, defining software components and interfaces, making technology and design decisions, and guiding engineering teams through implementation. The platform brings together backend services, external content sources, delivery networks, operational systems and end-user applications. Strong software architecture and backend engineering experience is essential. Prior broadcasting or media-domain experience is not required. This is a hands-on architecture role. The candidate must be comfortable moving between system design and code: writing or prototyping code when needed, reviewing production implementations, debugging complex issues, and working directly with developers to ensure architectural decisions are implemented effectively. This is a software and system architecture role-not a cloud infrastructure, DevOps or operations architecture role. Key Responsibilities Translate business, functional and non-functional requirements into end-to-end system architecture and clear engineering specifications. Define service boundaries, software components, interfaces, data flows and interaction patterns across the platform. Produce and maintain high-level and detailed design artifacts, including component, sequence,deployment-context and data-flow diagrams, API contracts and architecture decision records. Design distributed, service-oriented systems for scalability, performance, high availability, resilience and maintainability. Define API and integration architecture for applications, content providers, external systems and operational platforms. Design data storage, caching, messaging, asynchronous processing and event-driven interactions appropriate to system requirements. Evaluate architectural options and document trade-offs involving latency, throughput, consistency,reliability, complexity and cost. Guide backend and application teams through implementation, review designs and code-level approaches, and resolve cross-component technical issues. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes and evolving capacity needs; ensure architecture meets security,observability and operational requirements. Work with DevOps, infrastructure and security specialists on deployment and production-readiness,while retaining ownership of software architecture. Mentor developers, review implementation choices and help diagnose and resolve complex code-level and cross-service issues. Conduct code reviews to ensure implementations align with architecture, design principles, performance requirements and engineering quality standards. Participate in hands-on coding, technical spikes and proof-of-concept implementations when needed to validate designs or resolve difficult engineering problems. Required Experience and Skills 10-15 years of software engineering experience, with substantial responsibility for software or system architecture. Strong hands-on background in backend software development using Java, Go, Python, C# or comparable languages. Demonstrated ownership of the architecture of at least one complex software platform, from requirements and design through engineering delivery and production. Proven ability to decompose complex requirements into services, components, interfaces, APIs and data models. Strong grasp of distributed systems, microservices and service-oriented design; REST/gRPC APIs asynchronous messaging and event-driven systems. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, caching, messaging/streaming systems and system integration patterns. Ability to reason about concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, performance, horizontal scaling and architectural trade-offs. Ability to communicate architecture clearly through design documents, diagrams, reviews and discussions with engineering and product stakeholders. Practical familiarity with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and cloud-native application patterns. Demonstrated experience reviewing code and providing implementation-level technical direction to engineering teams. Current hands-on coding ability in at least one backend language, with willingness to write, review and debug production-quality code when required. Supporting Technical Knowledge Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, load balancing and deployment models. Understanding of authentication, authorization, data protection, monitoring, observability, failover and disaster recovery as system design considerations. Good to Have Experience with large-scale consumer applications, multi-tenant SaaS, e-commerce or high-transaction platforms. Experience with OTT/video, content delivery, CDN integration, telecom/media or device management platforms. Experience with real-time data processing and platforms serving large device or user populations. Who Should Apply This role is suited to Software Architects, System Architects, Backend Architects and Platform Architects Who have personally designed and delivered complex distributed software systems. Candidates whose experience is primarily cloud provisioning, Kubernetes administration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation or production operations-without substantial software design and development ownership-are unlikely to be a fit. What We Are Looking For An architect who can explain why a system is structured a particular way, defend design choices, anticipate failure modes, and work closely with developers to turn architecture into production software. This person should be capable of coding, reviewing code and debugging when needed, without being expected to carry a routine full-time development workload.

description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for an HR professional with a strong focus on Talent Acquisition (80%) along with supporting HR Operations (20%). The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment, strong stakeholder management skills, and a basic understanding of employee lifecycle processes. Job Type: Full time

Screen CVs and conduct initial HR screening/interviews. Shortlist candidates based on job requirements and organizational fit. Coordinate technical, managerial, and HR interview rounds. Support probation confirmation and performance review processes. Assist with employee engagement activities and HR communications. Coordinate exit formalities, asset handover, and Full Final settlement inputs. Prepare basic HR reports, MIS, and trackers. Support HR policies, processes, and compliance documentation. Coordinate with Finance, IT, Admin, and other departments for employee-related requirements. 
 
 Requirements

Good stakeholder management and coordination abilities. Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously. Strong negotiation and follow-up skills. Good understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 
 
 Experience Qualification

title: Video Editing And Graphic Designer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION CONTENT & VIDEO CREATOR Kingdom Organic Farm Pvt. Ltd. makers of Kala Sona™ premium organic soil inputs ROLE AT A GLANCE Job Title: Content & Video Creator Department: Marketing & Brand Reports To: Founder & Managing Director Employment Type: Full-time, permanent (on-site) Work Location: Office at Old Railway Road, Gurgaon, Haryana, with regular visits to our farm and outdoor shooting sites Working Days: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM (Sunday off) Experience: Minimum 2–3 years in content creation / video production Salary: Rs 30,000 per month in hand (net take-home) Joining: Immediate, within November 2026 Openings: 1 ABOUT US Kingdom Organic Farm Pvt. Ltd. is a Gurgaon-based manufacturer of premium, lab-tested, 100% organic soil inputs sold under our brand Kala Sona™. We produce vermicompost, organic potting mix, Neemkhali, Bonemeal and Neem Oil at our own 4-acre farm and sell through our website, Amazon, Flipkart, nurseries and institutional buyers. Our content is built on real farm processes, real people and honest storytelling – from drone shots of our windrow beds to potting tutorials and story-based ads. We are now growing our in-house content team and are looking for a creative, hands-on person who loves the camera, the edit timeline and the outdoors equally. ROLE SUMMARY The Content & Video Creator will own day-to-day creation of video and photo content for the Kala Sona brand – planning, shooting, editing and publishing reels, shorts, long-form YouTube videos and creative product photos. The role combines on-site shooting at the farm and field locations with studio/office editing, social media posting and disciplined management of our media library. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Shooting & Production - Plan and shoot videos and photos at the office, our farm, nurseries, customer sites and other outdoor locations. - Accompany and assist the team during shoots – camera setup, lighting, audio, framing, B-roll capture and shot-list execution. - Operate and take good care of company-owned recording equipment, including DSLR camera, drone, GoPro action camera, wireless microphones and smartphones. - Capture creative product photography for the website, marketplaces (Amazon/Flipkart), catalogues and social media. 2. Editing & Post-Production - Edit reels, YouTube Shorts, long-form YouTube videos, ads and tutorials in Adobe Premiere Pro. - Create motion graphics, titles, lower-thirds and animated elements in Adobe After Effects. - Retouch and design images in Adobe Photoshop and Canva (thumbnails, posters, carousels, banners). - Use Adobe Firefly and other AI tools for image generation, background extension, visual ideas and faster post-production. - Handle colour correction, audio clean-up, music and sound design, subtitles and export for each platform's format. 3. Content Writing & AI-Assisted Creation - Write clear, engaging English captions, video scripts, hooks, titles, descriptions and hashtags. - Use AI tools smartly across the content workflow – ideation, scripting, voice-over, subtitles, image and video generation, editing assistance – while keeping the output authentic and on-brand. - Contribute ideas for new formats, trends, series and campaigns. 4. Social Media Publishing - Post and schedule finished content on our social media platforms (Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and others as required). - Maintain a regular posting calendar and ensure every post follows the Kala Sona brand look and tone. - Track basic performance (views, reach, engagement) and share learnings to improve future content. - Respond to or flag comments and messages to the team as required. 5. Data Management & Media Library - Offload, sort, rename and back up all photo and video footage on the office computer and storage drives after every shoot. - Follow the company's folder structure and file-naming convention so that footage is easy to find and reuse. - Maintain project files, raw footage, final exports and brand assets in an organised, secure manner. 6. General - Coordinate with the founder, farm team and other staff for shoot schedules and content requirements. - Meet agreed deadlines and output targets. - Take on other related creative tasks assigned from time to time. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS - Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in content creation, video shooting and editing (agency, brand, media house or freelance). - Software: Efficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Firefly and Canva. - AI Tools: Practical, working knowledge of using AI in content creation (e.g. AI image/video generation, scripting, voice-over, captions/subtitles, editing assistants). - Writing: Good command of written English for captions, scripts and descriptions. Working knowledge of Hindi is an advantage for communicating with field teams. - Camera Skills: Comfortable shooting with DSLR, action cameras and smartphones; understanding of composition, lighting and audio. - Social Media: Good understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, long-form YouTube and current content trends. - Education: Graduate in any discipline; a degree/diploma in mass communication, film-making, multimedia, animation or design is preferred. - Portfolio: A portfolio or showreel of previous work (reels, YouTube videos, photos, designs) is mandatory. Good to Have - Experience flying a drone for aerial shots. - Experience creating content for agriculture, gardening, D2C, FMCG or e-commerce brands. - Basic knowledge of YouTube SEO, thumbnails and analytics. - Own two-wheeler and a valid driving licence for local travel. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES - Enthusiastic and curious; genuinely excited to work with professional recording gadgets. - Comfortable working outdoors at the farm and field sites in all seasons. - Self-motivated, organised and able to manage multiple projects to deadline. - Careful and responsible with company equipment and data. - Open to feedback and a strong team player. WORKING CONDITIONS - Office Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM. Sunday is a weekly off. - Field Work: Regular visits to the company farm and other shooting sites as part of the role. Shoot timings may occasionally shift for natural light (early morning / evening), with adjustment as per company policy. - Relocation: The candidate must be based in, or willing to relocate to, Gurgaon. - Equipment: All shooting and editing equipment and software is provided by the company and must be used for company work only. HOLIDAYS & LEAVE The following national and festival holidays are paid holidays: - Republic Day – 26 January - Holi - Independence Day – 15 August - Gandhi Jayanti – 2 October - Diwali Other leave will be as per company leave policy. COMPENSATION & TERMS - Salary: Rs 30,000 per month in hand (net take-home salary, credited monthly). - Probation: 3 months, after which employment is confirmed subject to satisfactory performance. - Notice Period: 30 days on either side after confirmation. - Travel: Official travel to farm and shooting sites will be arranged or reimbursed as per company policy. - Confidentiality & Ownership: All photos, videos, designs, raw footage and other content created during employment are the sole property of Kingdom Organic Farm Pvt. title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Job Description Technical Program Manager (TPM) 
 Band B14 | Digital Product Management & Innovation Enterprise digital product delivery, GenAI transformation, and technical program leadership Function PMDI Location Bangalore 
 Position Summary The Technical Program Manager (TPM) assists with the end-to-end delivery of strategically important digital products and transformation initiatives, GenAI solutions, platforms, and innovation programs. Sitting at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, business transformation, and enterprise architecture, the TPM converts business opportunities into scalable, production-ready capabilities that create measurable business value. This role is accountable for technical program leadership from discovery through realization, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, aligned to enterprise standards, and positioned for long-term adoption and value realization. The TPM operates as a senior leader across business, product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and third-party partners. 
 Why This Role Exists As Kraft Heinz accelerates its Digital, Data, AI, and Innovation agenda, the organization needs leaders who can bridge business ambition with technical execution. The TPM ensures successful delivery of complex digital initiatives by aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and driving measurable outcomes. 
 Key Responsibilities Responsibility Area What the TPM Owns Strategic Program Leadership - Support role on complex enterprise programs spanning multiple business functions, geographies, and technology domains. - Translate business goals into executable technical roadmaps and delivery strategies. - Drive prioritization decisions, sequencing, funding discussions, and value realization planning. - Facilitate build, buy, reuse, and partner decisions with architecture and capability leaders. Product & Delivery Execution - Assist with delivery planning from discovery through deployment and value realization. - Establish and manage program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and resource requirements. - Coordinate execution across product, engineering, data science, architecture, cybersecurity, and external vendors. - Drive stage-gate governance and executive readiness reviews. Technical Leadership - Partner with engineering and architecture teams to validate solution approaches and technical feasibility. - Lead technical design reviews and execution planning. - Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and operational requirements. - Guide proof-of-concept and MVP initiatives through validation and production scaling. Stakeholder & Change Leadership - Build partnerships with executive sponsors, functional leaders, and technology teams. - Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and value delivery to senior leadership. - Facilitate alignment across competing priorities and stakeholder groups. - Drive adoption planning, change management, and benefit realization strategies. Governance & Financial Management - Manage program budgets, vendor engagements, and investment plans. - Establish KPIs, success criteria, and outcome measurement frameworks. - Drive risk, issue, dependency, and escalation management. - Validate benefits realization and program ROI. Team Leadership - Lead and mentor program managers, analysts, contractors, and cross-functional delivery teams. - Create a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. - Develop delivery frameworks, best practices, and repeatable operating models. - Contribute to the growth and maturity of the TPM discipline across PM&DI. Success Measures Business Outcomes Delivery Excellence Organizational Impact - Adoption and business value realized - Revenue growth, productivity gains, cost savings, or risk reduction - Stakeholder satisfaction - On-time delivery - Budget adherence - Quality and stability of delivered solutions - Successful program scaling - Executive stakeholder trust - Cross-functional alignment - Improvement of delivery methodologies - Advancement of Digital and AI transformation objectives 
 Qualifications Required Preferred - Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field. - 8+ years leading complex technology programs or digital transformations. - Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, data, AI, or digital product initiatives. - Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in matrixed organizations. - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, agile delivery, architecture principles, and platform ecosystems. - Experience managing executive stakeholders and enterprise governance processes. - Excellent communication, facilitation, and influence skills. - MBA or Master degree. - PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, Agile, or equivalent certification. - Experience with GenAI, advanced analytics, data platforms, or machine learning solutions. - Experience in consumer goods, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, or corporate functions. - Experience managing external system integrators and technology vendors. 
 Leadership Expectations at B14 - Shapes strategy rather than only executing plans. - Leads through influence across multiple organizations. - Makes complex tradeoff decisions with enterprise implications. - Balances innovation with operational excellence. - Develops talent and creates scalable delivery practices. - Establishes direction, priorities, and execution frameworks for others to follow. Distinction vs. Product Manager Product Manager Technical Program Manager Owns business value and product vision Owns technical execution and delivery Prioritizes outcomes and roadmap Orchestrates delivery and dependency management Defines what should be built Defines how it gets delivered Leads customer and business discovery Leads technical planning and execution Accountable for product success Accountable for program success Location(s) Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC

description:
Job Summary Certinal is looking for a Product Manager to support the product team across discovery, specification and delivery for our e-Signature and e-Consent platform. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales and customer success to turn customer problems into shipped, well-defined product. This is an execution-focused role for someone early in their product career. You will write the stories, chase the details, keep the backlog honest and make sure what ships matches what was agreed. Because Certinal operates in regulated healthcare, you will also learn to treat audit trails, evidence and compliance requirements as first-class product concerns rather than afterthoughts. Reports to: Khanjan Kotecha Experience: 4 to 8 years in product management or a closely related role, including a minimum of 1 year in healthcare SaaS. Location: Bengaluru, India Employment Type: Full time Responsibilities Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirement documents from agreed problem statements. Groom and maintain the backlog alongside engineering and QA, and keep priorities, dependencies and status current. Participate in sprint planning, refinement and review, and unblock engineering questions during the sprint. Triage customer feedback, support tickets and field requests into themes with evidence and frequency attached. Run structured competitive teardowns of e-signature and e-consent products and keep a living comparison current. Translate regulatory and security requirements into testable acceptance criteria in partnership with Pre-Sales and Engineering. Support release planning, write release notes, and prepare internal enablement material for Sales and Customer Success. Track adoption, funnel and usage metrics in product analytics, and report on how shipped features actually perform. Assist with beta and pilot programmes, including participant selection, feedback capture and readout. Strong written communication; able to write a requirement that an engineer can build from without a follow-up meeting. Structured problem-solving and comfort breaking an ambiguous request into scoped, sequenced work. Hands-on experience with an issue tracker such as Jira or Azure DevOps. Working familiarity with Figma and the ability to review and give useful feedback on designs. Basic SQL and comfort working with product analytics tools. Genuine curiosity about how enterprise software is bought, deployed and audited. Bachelors degree in engineering, computer science, or an equivalent analytical discipline. Preferred Exposure to B2B or enterprise SaaS rather than consumer products. Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks and reading API documentation.  Strong track record of taking product requirements from ideation and discovery through development and successful delivery.

title: Senior Product & Client Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Senior Product & Client Manager with strong domain expertise in Pharmacovigilance (PV) and Drug Safety systems. The candidate will work closely with the Product Management and Client Management functions, supporting the management and continuous enhancement of Clinevo Safety, our Pharmacovigilance Safety Database product. 
 The role requires a strong combination of product management, functional expertise, client relationship management and techno-functional knowledge of global drug safety systems. The candidate will be responsible for understanding client and regulatory requirements, managing product enhancements, coordinating implementation and migration activities, supporting client engagements and ensuring successful delivery of product releases. Experience with established global safety databases such as Oracle Argus Safety, ArisG, Veeva Vault Safety or other enterprise Pharmacovigilance platforms is highly desirable . Key Responsibilities 1. Product Management & Strategy Understand the product roadmap, business objectives and functional capabilities of Clinevo Safety. Gather, analyse and document product requirements, client requests and regulatory-driven enhancements. Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS) and user stories. Coordinate with development and QA teams to ensure requirements are translated into functional specifications and delivered as expected. Review product functionality, identify gaps and recommend improvements based on industry practices and client requirements. Manage product enhancement requests, prioritization, release planning and delivery timelines. Participate in product demonstrations, requirement discussions and feature walkthroughs. Ensure product functionality aligns with global Pharmacovigilance business processes and regulatory expectations. 2. Client Relationship & Account Management Act as a key point of contact for assigned global pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. Manage client relationships, regular review meetings, project discussions and escalations. Understand client business processes and translate their requirements into appropriate product solutions. Lead functional discussions, requirement clarification sessions and product demonstrations. Manage client expectations, commitments, deliverables and project dependencies. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of client issues and requests. Prepare project status reports, meeting minutes, action items and management updates. Support client onboarding, implementation, go-live and post-production activities. 3. Pharmacovigilance Domain & Regulatory Compliance Strong understanding of global Pharmacovigilance processes and drug safety case management. Knowledge of ICH E2B(R2) and E2B(R3) regulatory reporting requirements. Understanding of global regulatory reporting requirements, including FDA, EMA, MHRA and other health authorities. Knowledge of safety case processing, intake, triage, data entry, medical review, quality control and regulatory submissions. Understanding of CIOMS, MedWatch, PADER, PSUR and other regulatory reporting formats. Experience with regulatory gateway integrations, electronic submissions and acknowledgements. Stay informed about regulatory changes and assess their impact on product functionality. 4. Implementation & Data Migration Management Coordinate end-to-end Pharmacovigilance system implementation and client onboarding activities. Understand legacy safety database structures and support migration planning. Manage migration requirements involving E2B XML (R2/R3), Non-E2B exports and supporting attachments. Coordinate with migration, technical and client teams for data extraction, transformation, loading and reconciliation. Review migration outputs, identify discrepancies and coordinate resolution. Support system configuration, user acceptance testing (UAT), go-live planning and post-implementation activities. Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies and risks. 5. Release Management & Quality Compliance Coordinate product release planning, enhancement delivery and release communication. Review functional changes and ensure appropriate testing and documentation. Support preparation and review of release notes, validation documentation and user guides. Coordinate IQ, OQ and PQ activities, where applicable. Handle client QA queries, audit observations, deviations, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) discussions. Ensure product enhancements and changes are appropriately assessed, documented and communicated. Work closely with QA and development teams to ensure quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle. 6. Cross-functional Team Coordination Work closely with Development, QA, IT, Migration and Implementation teams. Translate business requirements into clear and actionable technical deliverables. Track task assignments, progress, priorities and delivery commitments. Identify project risks, technical dependencies and potential delivery challenges. Coordinate resolution of critical production issues and client escalations. Provide functional guidance and domain knowledge to internal teams.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security
description:
Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineering Manager within HPE s Product Security Office (PSO), you will build and lead a high-performing development team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, reliable, and scalable software. Your team will deliver applications, platforms, APIs, automation, and integrations that enable product teams to identify, manage, and reduce security risk across the product lifecycle. This is a build-and-scale people leadership role. You will create the team environment, delivery discipline, and engineering practices needed to turn product security priorities into dependable capabilities used across HPE. You will set clear priorities, develop engineering talent, establish repeatable operating mechanisms, and ensure the team delivers measurable outcomes with strong security, quality, reliability, and maintainability. Operating within PSO s matrixed model, you will balance shared engineering capacity across multiple product security capabilities, partnering with capability owners who define business outcomes and priorities while retaining accountability for people leadership, engineering execution, and technical delivery. You will bring enough technical depth to guide decisions, challenge approaches, review engineering quality, and remove obstacles while holding engineers accountable for technical ownership and execution. You will partner with PSO leaders, product and capability owners, architects, program managers, product engineering teams, and adjacent cybersecurity organizations to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and scale solutions across diverse product environments. The role manages individual contributors and succeeds by building a capable team-not by acting as the primary architect or personally owning every technical decision. 
 What you ll do: Build and Lead the Engineering Team Hire, onboard, lead, and develop a team of individual-contributor software and security engineers, setting clear expectations, goals, development plans, and accountability for results. Create an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge. Provide regular coaching, feedback, career development, and performance support while building succession strength and expanding the team s technical capabilities. Match work to skills and development needs, delegate meaningful ownership, and ensure senior engineers lead design and implementation within clear decision boundaries. Plan team capacity, workload, and skill coverage; identify resourcing risks and recommend hiring, development, or partner strategies. 
 Drive Engineering Delivery and Operations Translate Product Security Office priorities and capability roadmaps into clear engineering plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes. Lead day-to-day engineering execution, including prioritization, sprint and release planning, dependency management, risk tracking, escalation, and delivery reviews. Ensure the team builds and operates secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, services, automation, APIs, data integrations, and product security tooling. Establish effective engineering practices for design review, source control, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, incident response, and operational support. Balance new capability development with operational reliability, technical debt reduction, defect remediation, platform modernization, and lifecycle maintenance. Define and monitor meaningful measures for delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, adoption, and engineering effectiveness. 
 Shape Product Security Capabilities Partner with product and capability owners to understand user needs, clarify requirements, prioritize engineering investments, and sequence delivery across the Product Security Office capability portfolio. Guide development of reusable product security platforms and services that improve vulnerability management, security assessment, secure development, reporting, workflow automation, or related security outcomes. Promote automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering where they improve speed, consistency, coverage, or user experience while preserving validation, traceability, security, and human accountability. Ensure security, privacy, data-handling, resilience, and compliance considerations are incorporated into solution design and delivery. Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and engineering insights to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, integration, and continuous improvement. 
 Lead Across Teams and Boundaries Build strong working relationships across Product Security, product engineering, security research, vulnerability response, infrastructure, architecture, and enterprise technology teams. Align stakeholders on priorities, scope, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments, escalating material risks with clear options and recommendations. Provide transparent capacity, dependency, and engineering investment tradeoffs across the PSO portfolio, helping leadership determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, scaled, modernized, consolidated, or retired. Coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams and partners while establishing clear ownership, handoffs, documentation, and operating rhythms. Communicate engineering progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders. Represent the team in planning, architecture, operational, and leadership forums while ensuring individual contributors retain appropriate technical visibility and ownership. 
 What you need to bring: Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Typically 10 or more years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or technology experience, including 3+ years of people management experience directly managing software engineers. Proven experience leading teams that design, build, release, and operate enterprise software, platforms, services, automation, or developer-facing capabilities. Demonstrated ability to manage individual contributors, develop talent, set clear priorities, address performance issues, and create accountability for delivery and engineering quality. Experience establishing or improving engineering practices across software design, code review, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, and operational support. Experience managing roadmaps, delivery plans, dependencies, technical debt, operational risk, and competing stakeholder priorities in a complex or matrixed organization. Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud environments, containers, data platforms, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices. Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries. Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL or NoSQL data platforms, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies. Experience applying AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or agentic methods within secure engineering workflows, including appropriate validation and human oversight. Experience improving engineering operating models, building a new team or capability, or scaling a platform from project-based delivery to sustainable operations. Working knowledge of common software weaknesses, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, software supply-chain security, and secure development lifecycle principles. Relevant engineering, cloud, agile, or security certifications are helpful but not required. 
 What Success Looks Like A capable, engaged engineering team has clear priorities, meaningful ownership, strong development support, and accountability for outcomes. Product security capabilities move from ambiguous needs to predictable delivery through clear roadmaps, operating rhythms, engineering standards, and decision ownership. Software and automation are secure, reliable, maintainable, measurable, and supported through disciplined lifecycle and operational practices. Product and capability owners have a trusted engineering partner that provides transparent delivery commitments, credible tradeoffs, and timely escalation of risks. Reusable platforms, integrations, automation, and engineering practices reduce fragmentation and improve the scale and effectiveness of Product Security Office capabilities. title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management

The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load. Role Overview About the team: Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSKs security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job. Key Responsibilities This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited - including telling a programme director that their review will not be. Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly. Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name. Develop the analyst teams domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two. Own the quality of what the practice produces - review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline - and correct it at the individual level when it drops. Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained. Manage the analyst teams day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms. Carry roughly a third of a reviewer caseload yourself on Tier 2 designs, so allocation decisions are informed by current technical judgement rather than administration. Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated. Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards. Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your teams ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSKs Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. Regulated industry experience, including GxP and audit evidence standards Protecting senior review capacity by absorbing day-to-day allocation and demand management into the delivery layer. title: Product and Deployment Lead
description:
About Lifesight 
 Lifesight is a Unified Marketing Measurement platform that helps marketers make better decisions. We're a team of 130+ professionals serving 300+ customers across five offices in the US, Singapore, India, Australia, and the UK. 
 We're building advanced marketing intelligence and AI-powered solutions that help businesses make smarter decisions, automate workflows, and improve operational efficiency. 
 About the Role 
 Lifesight is seeking a Product & Deployment Lead to help shape AI-powered products, deliver customer solutions, and establish scalable implementation processes. 
 You will work closely with the founders, engineering teams, and customers, combining product management, hands-on engineering, and operational ownership. 
 The role involves understanding business problems, building AI-powered solutions, managing deployments, and ensuring successful customer adoption. 
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role with opportunities to develop and lead a team as the business grows. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Management & Development Work closely with founders to translate the product vision into a clear roadmap and achievable releases. Engage with customers to understand their business processes, challenges, and priorities. Identify opportunities to improve business operations through AI and automation. Define product requirements, workflow designs, and measurable success criteria. Prioritize features and improvements based on customer needs and business impact. Convert recurring customer requirements into scalable and reusable product capabilities. 
 AI Solution Development & Deployment Work with customer teams to understand their data, business requirements, and technical environments. Build and implement integrations, data mappings, AI workflows, agent configurations, and user interfaces. Use Python or TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, and AI coding tools to develop and troubleshoot solutions. Build and deploy LLM-powered workflows and AI agents , including tool integrations and human-in-the-loop processes. Test solutions across different scenarios, identify potential failures, and implement appropriate recovery mechanisms. Collaborate with engineering teams and customer IT teams during pilots, production deployment, and stabilization. Develop reusable implementation frameworks and technical documentation. 
 Customer Implementation & Delivery Own customer engagements from requirement gathering and solution design through deployment and handover. Manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables. Communicate progress, identify potential risks, and resolve implementation challenges. Conduct customer onboarding, training, and knowledge-transfer sessions. Ensure customers can independently operate deployed solutions and manage supported exceptions. Monitor solution performance, customer adoption, and business outcomes after deployment. 
 Process Improvement & Operations Develop standardized processes for customer discovery, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Maintain accurate records of customer requirements, project progress, and support activities. Track implementation effort, operating costs, and delivery capacity. Identify opportunities to automate internal workflows using AI-powered solutions. Capture customer feedback and implementation learnings to improve future product development. Help establish scalable product, deployment, and operational practices as the organization grows. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, technical product management, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or AI-powered automation. Strong hands-on programming experience with Python or TypeScript/JavaScript . Proficiency in SQL, REST APIs, system integrations, and debugging . Practical experience developing or deploying Generative AI, LLM-based workflows, AI agents, or workflow automation solutions . Familiarity with LLM tool calling, evaluation, business-context integration, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and working products. Strong understanding of product discovery, requirement gathering, prioritization, and solution design. Experience managing end-to-end implementations, from initial discovery through production deployment and customer adoption. Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment. Experience using AI-assisted development tools to build, review, and debug code. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience working with B2B SaaS products or enterprise software . Exposure to ERP, CRM, and third-party system integrations . Experience with customer-hosted deployments or enterprise IT environments. Familiarity with business process automation and operational workflows. Previous experience in a startup or early-stage product environment. Experience building reusable AI solutions for multiple customers. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Successfully deliver AI-powered solutions that improve customer business operations. Ensure customers actively use deployed solutions and can manage supported workflows independently. Maintain clear implementation plans, timelines, and stakeholder communication. Convert customer feedback into meaningful product improvements. Build reusable deployment processes that reduce implementation time and improve scalability. 
 Why Join Lifesight? 
 Work closely with founders and engineering teams on innovative AI-powered products. Take ownership of product development, technical implementation, and customer delivery. Build practical AI solutions that solve real business problems. Gain exposure to product strategy, engineering, and enterprise customer engagement. Contribute to establishing scalable processes and practices as the business grows. Be part of a collaborative team working at the intersection of AI, technology, and business operations. 
 How to Apply 
 When applying, tell us about a product, AI solution, or workflow you helped take from an initial business problem to real-world use. 
 We would love to understand what you personally built or owned, the challenges you faced, and the impact your solution created. You may also share a relevant project, demo, or portfolio if you have permission to do so.

title: Product Implementation Manager
description:
Job Summary The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade. The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth. In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization. What you ll be doing Portfolio Management Product Lifecycle Support Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership. Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance. Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products. Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities. Data Governance, Analytics Portfolio Optimization Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions. Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making. Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement. Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities. Strategic Portfolio Support Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans. Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions. Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations. Compliance, Quality Governance Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records. Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation. Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements. Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation. PPAP, Licensing Project Support Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities. Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support. Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable. Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance. Digital Enablement Continuous Improvement Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools. Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows. Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams. Stakeholder Collaboration Execution Support Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders. Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams. Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders. Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption. Leadership Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels) Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs. Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement. Support long-term capability development across the PIM community. Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise. Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams. What you bring A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage. Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements. Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.

description:
About Us Pluang is Indonesia's leading multi-asset investment platform, offering diverse products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, US Options, Mutual Funds, and Gold. With a mission to become the primary money app for Indonesians, we provide a seamless, innovative, and secure experience to empower millions of Indonesians to achieve financial independence. We are an AI-native fintech. We build AI into our products, and every team uses AI in its daily work. Backed by $110M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we are one of Indonesia's fastest-growing fintechs. 
 We're hiring a Product Manager - Platform based in Gurgaon to own and build cutting-edge, AI-powered trading tools, optimize onboarding processes, and enhance user experience. This role is an opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, shape product strategy, and solve meaningful problems in the fast-evolving world of digital finance. Join Pluang and play a part in shaping the future of investing in Indonesia. 
 
 What You Will Do As the Product Manager - Platform, you will work on the following initiatives and more: 
 
 
 Trading Platform Product Development Own the roadmap for the core trading experience, including the trade page, order placement, charts and portfolio, and make it simple to use across every asset class. Work closely with engineers to build scalable features that work across crypto, US stocks, Indonesian stocks, gold and mutual funds. Onboarding Optimization Own user onboarding and KYC journeys, reducing friction while maintaining security. Partner with teams to streamline onboarding processes while improving user experience. Optimize identity verification, automated approvals, and authentication mechanisms. Trading Tools, Salesforce Chatbot Enhancements Build and improve trading tools such as Signals, Screeners, price alerts and Auto Invest, along with market insights. Improve charting features, order types, and portfolio tracking for traders. Work on Salesforce integrations to improve customer relationship management and automate workflows. Build and improve the admin panel and internal tools that our operations, compliance and support teams use every day, and remove manual work and errors from their jobs. Improve the chatbot to optimize customer support and user engagement. Build AI products that change how Indonesians trade, from Aura, our AI assistant that gives every user personalised insights and trade recommendations, to our MCP server, which lets users research and trade on Pluang from AI agents like Claude. Data-Driven Product Enhancements Analyze market trends, user behavior, and platform performance to inform product decisions. Run A/B tests, gather trader feedback, and iterate on key platform features.
