title: Manager HR
description:
Job Description Manager, Human Resources (Caf Operations) 
 Function: Human Resources
 Designation: Manager HR
 Location: New Delhi
 Role Overview The Manager – HR will be responsible for managing end-to-end HR operations for the caf business, with a primary focus on frontline recruitment, employee lifecycle management, HR documentation, attendance and employee relations. The role involves regular caf visits, close coordination with Operations teams and ensuring consistent implementation of HR policies, processes and statutory requirements across assigned locations. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Frontline Recruitment & Manpower Planning Manage end-to-end recruitment for caf frontline positions, including Team Members, Shift Managers, Caf Managers and other operational roles. Coordinate with Operations and Area Managers to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely closures. Drive local sourcing through walk-ins, referrals, job portals and other relevant channels. Track vacancies, joining ratios, hiring TAT and manpower availability across assigned cafs. 2. Employee Documentation & Onboarding Coordinate joining formalities and ensure timely completion of employee documentation and verification. Ensure appointment letters, employee records and other statutory documents are completed and maintained. Coordinate with Payroll and HR teams for employee code generation and onboarding-related requirements. Ensure adherence to defined joining processes and documentation standards. 3. Caf Visits & HR Operations Conduct regular caf visits to interact with employees and Operations teams and understand ground-level HR concerns. Review employee documentation, attendance, manpower deployment and compliance-related records. Identify process gaps and ensure timely corrective action in coordination with the respective stakeholders. Support the implementation of HR policies, processes and initiatives across cafs. 4. Attendance, Exits & Employee Lifecycle Management Monitor attendance, absenteeism, irregularities and employee availability across assigned locations. Coordinate with Operations and Payroll for attendance regularisation and timely resolution of discrepancies. Track employee exits, resignations, absconding cases, full and final settlements and exit documentation. Maintain accurate employee movement and separation records. 5. Employee Relations & Grievance Management Address frontline employee grievances and coordinate with Operations for timely resolution. Participate in disciplinary meetings, conduct employee discussions and coordinate issuance of warning letters, show-cause notices and other disciplinary communications. Support investigations and documentation of employee-related cases in consultation with the HR leadership. Ensure consistent and fair application of disciplinary processes. 6. Statutory Compliance & HR Governance Coordinate local compliance checks at cafs and ensure availability of required employee and statutory records. Support internal and external HR audits and facilitate closure of identified gaps. Ensure adherence to company policies, HR SOPs and applicable labour regulations. Maintain trackers and reports on compliance, documentation and employee-related matters. 7. Stakeholder Coordination & HR Reporting Work closely with Regional Operations, Area Managers and Caf Managers on all people-related matters. Act as the primary HR point of contact for assigned locations. Prepare periodic reports on hiring, manpower gaps, attendance, attrition, exits and employee concerns. Drive HR initiatives and ensure timely communication and implementation at the caf level. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 5–8 years of HR experience, preferably in Retail, QSR, FMCG, Hospitality or other multi-location businesses. Strong experience in frontline/high-volume recruitment and HR operations. Good understanding of employee documentation, attendance, payroll coordination and labour compliance. Experience handling employee grievances and disciplinary matters. Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. Willingness to travel extensively and conduct regular caf visits. Good communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS platforms.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Indus Parking Services (IPS) is an emerging parking enforcement company headquartered in Gurugram, India. Our team consists of highly focused and motivated professionals with extensive expertise in parking management. We specialise in preventing unauthorised parking across commercial properties, residential complexes, and other locations. Indus Parking Services manages the entire parking enforcement process efficiently and also provides operational support to Euro Parking Services.
 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to join us, who plays a crucial role in leading the human resources function and supporting the overall growth of the organization. This position involves developing and implementing HR policies, managing recruitment and employee relations, and ensuring smooth coordination of HR and administrative activities across the company. The HR Manager contributes to building a positive workplace culture and upholding compliance with employment regulations and policies. 
 As an HR Manager , your responsibilities will include: Partnering with leadership to develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and procedures aligned with the company's overall business goals and objectives. Managing the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, including sourcing, job postings, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and extending job offers. Coordinating with new employees, onboarding and orientation programs to ensure a smooth transition into the organization. Administering and overseeing competitive employee benefits and compensation programs, including leave policies. Overseeing performance management processes, including employee evaluations, feedback sessions, and performance improvement plans. Handling employee relation issues, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and grievances, while nurturing a positive and productive workplace culture. Ensuring compliance with all relevant labor laws, regulations, and employment standards, including statutory filings and audits. Maintaining accurate employee records, including attendance and leave records, and HR databases/HRMS. Overseeing payroll processing and ensuring timely and accurate disbursement of salaries and wages. Providing HR support and guidance to managers and employees, using relevant HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions. Assessing training needs and coordinating learning and development programs to enhance employee skills and competencies. Overseeing office administration tasks, including facilities management, stakeholder coordination, and office supplies procurement. Monitoring and managing HR and office budgets, expenses, and cost-saving initiatives. Ensuring a safe and healthy work environment by implementing and enforcing safety policies and procedures. Building and managing effective interpersonal relationships at all levels of the organization to support business objectives. Staying updated on HR trends, employment legislation, and best practices to drive continuous improvement in HR and administrative processes. 
 The ideal candidate working as an HR Manager will display: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. A Masters degree or HR certification is preferred. Proven work experience as an HR Manager, Senior HR Generalist, or similar role, with at least 7-10 years of overall HR experience, including a minimum of 2 years in a supervisory or leadership capacity. Strong functional HR expertise across the areas outlined above. Demonstrable experience using HR metrics and reporting to support management decision-making. Strong understanding of labor laws, employment legislation, and compliance requirements. Excellent communication, active listening, negotiation, and presentation skills. Strong leadership and people management skills, with a proven ability to build, guide, and develop high-performing teams. Ability to work independently, help architect HR strategy, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Proficiency in HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) and MS Office applications. Attention to detail and accuracy in data management and record-keeping. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities with a proactive and solutions-oriented approach. Strong organizational and time management skills. 
 Benefits of working with IPA Indus Parking Services Limited as an HR Manager: Employee of the month programme Regular performance review to encourage internal growth 
 Timings: 11 am to 8 pm (Monday- Friday)

title: Pre-Sales Executive (Online)
description:
Company: PropPie (www.proppie.in) Location: Pune (Work from Office) Experience: 13 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Reports To: Head of Sales / Founder About PropPie PropPie is democratizing institutional real estate. We enable individuals to own fractional shares of Grade-A commercial assets—such as IT parks, data centers, and warehouses—starting at just 25 Lakhs, bypassing the traditional 25 Crore barrier to entry. Built on evidence, absolute transparency, and long-term wealth creation, we give investors priority access to vetted commercial spaces. We do not sell dreams; we sell meticulously structured, data-backed fractional ownership. The Role You are PropPie’s energetic online front door. As our Pre-Sales Executive (Online), you will own and manage the virtual funnel. Your objective is not to hit a mindless call volume target, but to qualify serious, sophisticated investors and seamlessly transition them to our sales closure team. You will be the face of our brand on webinars and video calls, requiring you to be highly articulate, presentable, and quick on your feet. What You Will Do Own the Online Engine: Plan, promote, and host live webinars, virtual investor conferences, and Q&A sessions. Manage the entire lifecycle from registrations and reminders to live hosting and 24-hour follow-ups. Drive Engagement: Reach out to inbound leads from digital campaigns and webinar registrations via phone, WhatsApp, email, and video calls. Educate & Simplify: Break down complex financial concepts in plain language. You will explain how fractional ownership works, how rental income and exits function, and clearly outline the associated risks to prospective investors. Qualify with Precision: Assess each lead’s investment capacity, intent, timeline, and decision-making authority. Log all intelligence meticulously into our CRM on the same day. Manage the Calendar: Book and confirm high-quality meetings for the Sales Executives, dispatch the correct pitch materials, and actively reduce meeting no-shows. Value-Driven Nurturing: Maintain regular, helpful touchpoints with leads who aren't ready to invest yet, building trust rather than applying pressure. Market Intelligence: Act as the ear to the ground, relaying investor objections, hard questions, and feedback to the product and sales leadership teams. Who You Are Education & Experience: You hold an MBA (Marketing, Sales, Finance, or General) or a degree in Hospitality Management (BHM). You have 1 to 3 years of professional experience. Exceptional Communicator: You possess highly fluent, confident, and energetic communication skills in English and Hindi (Marathi is a strong plus). You can speak clearly to a live online audience without sounding scripted. Street Smart & Resilient: You read people quickly, handle hard objections with calm professionalism, and remain completely composed when an investor says "no" or asks difficult questions. Fast Learner: You have the cognitive agility to absorb product mechanics, yield calculations, and risk parameters within days and explain them simply to a skeptic. Target-Oriented: You are punctual, presentable, and entirely comfortable being measured by metrics (webinar attendance rates, qualified leads, meetings booked/held, and CRM hygiene). What We DO NOT Require Prior real estate or broking experience. What You Will Learn Working directly with the founding team, you will receive a masterclass in commercial real estate fundamentals, rental yield mechanics, lease structures, and the end-to-end architecture of fractional property ownership.

description:
We are looking for a smart, elegant, confident and professionally presentable female candidate with excellent English communication and presentation skills for a client-facing Real Estate Sales position. The candidate must have 05 years of hands-on experience in residential real estate sales, particularly selling flats, apartments and residential properties in Mumbai. 
 The role involves interacting with prospective homebuyers, understanding their requirements, presenting suitable residential properties, conducting site visits across Andheri West and converting prospective enquiries into successful sales. 
 We are looking for someone with a polished personality, excellent interpersonal skills, strong sales acumen and the confidence to independently represent the organisation while dealing with clients. 
 Key Responsibilities: 1. Residential Property Sales Handle sales of residential properties, including flats, apartments and residential units. Generate, develop and follow up on prospective buyer leads. Understand customers' budgets, preferences, location requirements and property expectations. Present suitable property options and drive sales conversions. 2. Property Visits & Presentations Independently coordinate and conduct property visits across Andheri West, Mumbai. Personally accompany prospective buyers to showcase residential properties. Deliver professional and convincing property presentations, highlighting amenities, specifications, location advantages and pricing. Confidently address client queries and explain property features. 3. Client Relationship Management Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective homebuyers. Handle client meetings, discussions, negotiations and follow-ups. Understand customer objections and effectively communicate the value proposition. Maintain regular communication with interested buyers until deal closure. 4. Sales & Business Development Identify new sales opportunities through references, networking, online property portals and other channels. Coordinate with property owners, brokers, channel partners and other stakeholders. Maintain an updated database of leads, site visits, follow-ups and sales closures. Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth. 
 Candidate Requirements Female candidates only. Graduate in any discipline. 1 to 5 years of relevant experience in residential real estate sales. Prior experience in selling flats, apartments, residential projects or housing properties in Mumbai is essential. Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. Strong presentation, convincing and negotiation abilities. Smart, elegant, well-groomed and professionally presentable personality. Confident in independently meeting clients and showcasing properties. Good knowledge of Andheri West and surrounding Mumbai locations is preferred. Fluent in English and Hindi; Marathi will be an added advantage. Comfortable with fieldwork, local travel and regular property visits. Knowledge of MS Office, Excel, WhatsApp and CRM tools. A two-wheeler/four-wheeler and valid driving licence will be an advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile: We are specifically looking for a candidate who is: Articulate, confident and exceptionally good at communicating in English. Elegant, smart and professionally groomed. Comfortable interacting with high-value clients and prospective homebuyers. Capable of presenting and showcasing properties with confidence and professionalism. Sales-driven, proactive and focused on achieving closures. Responsible enough to independently manage client meetings, property visits and follow-ups. 
 Important: This is not a telecalling or back-office sales role. It is a field-oriented, client-facing position requiring independent property visits and direct interaction with prospective homebuyers across Andheri West.

description:

title: Content Creator and Social Media Manager
description:
Job Summary Why this role, and why now Procurement leaders research, validate, and shortlist vendors long before they ever talk to sales. Platforms like LinkedIn and YouTube have strong role to play alongside LLM and digital research, so social shouldn t be the last stop on a content plan. Were hiring for a brand new position, social-first Content Creator and Social Media Manager to run our channels and make content built for those channels from the ground up. We re looking for someone who thinks in posts, clips, and comments; who knows that in B2B, people follow people, not logos; and who gets how a well-shot 45-second video with an analyst can support a brand. About the role Youll be our in-house creator: putting people on camera and editing what you shoot, turning our analysts and leaders into visual and written content that people actually want to consume. Second, you ll run our social channels: calendar, drafting, publishing, community, and tone of voice. Youll work closely with the VP Communications and Content, Senior Content Marketing Manager, our marketing colleagues, our analysts and the wider business. Youll have good potential to shape things creatively, and youll see your work used quickly. What youll do Build a social-first content engine Create an exciting human-led social calendar for Beroe that maps quarterly creative peaks, and a regular drumbeat of activity. Make content thats built for the feed. Short, sharp, native to the platform. Taking long-form content or slide decks into socially engaging posts. Set up a small set of engaging B2B formats we can run every week: explainers, hot takes, category deep dives, analyst reactions, behind-the-scenes clips, exec POVs. When theres a big event, client story, report or webinar to work with, turn it into something that stands on its own in a feed. Ignite Beroes engagement levels Nurture procurement influencers with outreach, comments, engagement Nurture clients (people and accounts) with outreach, comments, engagement Support our people to be more active and engaging on social media - we would love to do a campaign such as #BeroeFreesFridays to communicate the value of a 4-day working week. Put our people on camera Get our analysts, execs, and colleagues on video and make them look and sound their best. Shoot and edit short-form video for LinkedIn (with a view to building out YouTube Shorts and Instagram content in the future), plus longer pieces for YouTube. Set up a lean production kit and workflow so we can capture content wherever it happens: office, events, on the road, over a call. Run our social channels Run our channels day to day. LinkedIn is our primary channel, followed by YouTube, and we have intentions to kickstart Instagram. Create channel plans for each, with Beroe s objectives skewed to the channel relevance - e.g. Instagram may have a different role and tone than LinkedIn. Own the calendar. Always-on posts, campaign moments, reactive content. Manage a rolling two-week plan in collaboration with the content team. Set the tone. We want to be fun, human, and credible without losing the professional edge our audience expects. Get press coverage, exec commentary, and product news into the feed. Make sure the right voices in the business are visible on social. Support marketing campaigns, launches, and industry events with content that gets traction with our target buyers. Measure and improve Watch the numbers: engagement (with a lens on target accounts), growth, audience quality. Report back monthly, with a deeper look every quarter. Feed what you learn into the next plan. More of what works, less of what doesnt. Stay on top of whats happening on social: new formats, new tools, what other B2B accounts are doing well. Bring the good stuff back into the team. What were looking for 4 to 5 years in social media, content creation, video production - ideally a combination of these - from agency, in-house or creator-side A body of work you can show us. Screenshots, links, showreel, whatever proves what you can do. You can shoot and edit video. Phone, DSLR, whatever youre most comfortable with. You know your way around CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or the equivalent. You have an eye for design. Knowledge of Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar. You have experience with, or are keen to explore how AI can help you get the job done. From content ideation and planning, to community management, to reporting and further - but keeping our tone human. You view your role as part of a bigger team s work - connected thinking and awareness of the bigger picture, rather than isolated focus on one task. You can write copy that sounds like a human wrote it. You know LinkedIn inside out. Youre curious about YouTube and Instagram for B2B, and you have views on which formats are working right now. Youre proactive and organized. You can juggle multiple shoots, posts, and stakeholders without dropping any of them. Youre good with people. You can walk into a room with a nervous analyst and a camera, and come out with something usable. Nice to have Background in B2B, SaaS, consulting or professional services. Any exposure to procurement or supply chain. Motion graphics, basic animation, or a working relationship with AI content tools. Experience helping other people build their own social presence. Why this is a good opportunity Youll shape how Beroe sounds and looks on social during our 20th year and beyond. Direct access to a global bench of category experts and senior leaders. The material is here if you can bring it out of them. Build out a newly created role, showing value to the business. Room to make things, deliver them, and learn. Working with a strong and ambitious team of Marketers who are supportive, collaborative, and care about the work.

title: Securities Operations Manager
description:
About this role: 
 The Operations Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership across Advisory Allocations and Trade Processing , with accountability for business delivery, risk and controls, people leadership, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement. The role oversees market-sensitive securities operations supporting trade allocation and settlement. Advisory Allocations is responsible for the timely and accurate processing of trade allocations and billing instructions received from money managers, while Trade Processing supports trade allocations, ex-clearing and step-out transactions, and resolution of settlement breaks by settlement date. The manager will be expected to develop a strong operating model, proactively manage risk and escalations, strengthen process expertise, and partner effectively with U.S. and India stakeholders 
 In this role, you will: Provide end-to-end leadership and oversight across Advisory Allocations and Trade Processing , ensuring timely, accurate and controlled execution of daily operations. Oversee critical activities including trade allocations, billing instructions, ex-clearing and step-out transactions, and settlement-break resolution . Maintain strong oversight of service levels, volumes, capacity, quality, operational exceptions, aged items and key business deliverables. Understand upstream and downstream dependencies across the trade lifecycle and proactively address issues that could impact allocation, settlement or client outcomes. Provide effective leadership during time-sensitive operational events and complex escalations. Risk Control Establish a strong risk and control environment with clear ownership, appropriate oversight and timely escalation of issues. Proactively identify operational and settlement risks and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Drive root-cause analysis for recurring errors, settlement breaks and control gaps, with sustainable remediation. Ensure procedures, controls, quality reviews, business continuity and cross-training remain current and effective. Promote a culture of strong control discipline, accountability and first-line risk ownership. People Leadership Lead, coach and develop managers, leads and team members across the functions. Build strong subject-matter expertise and adequate process depth across critical activities. Establish clear performance expectations and accountability while developing a strong succession and leadership pipeline. Drive cross-training and skill development to improve operational resilience and reduce key-person dependencies. Build broader business understanding within the team so that employees understand the business and risk rationale behind the processes , rather than only the procedural steps. Effectively manage capacity, workload distribution and resource deployment based on volumes and business priorities. Stakeholder Escalation Management Build strong relationships with U.S. leadership, business partners, money managers and other stakeholders supporting the trade lifecycle. Serve as the escalation point for significant operational issues, settlement risks and service concerns. Drive timely resolution of complex issues through effective collaboration across functions and locations. Provide clear, concise and timely communication to senior leadership on material risks, incidents, capacity concerns and remediation progress. Transformation Operational Excellence Identify and deliver opportunities to simplify, automate and standardize processes , while maintaining appropriate controls. Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention, operational risk and turnaround time. Use operational metrics, trend analysis and root-cause insights to identify efficiency and control opportunities. Drive transformation initiatives from identification through implementation and benefits realization. Promote continuous improvement and encourage teams to proactively identify opportunities beyond BAU delivery 
 Required Qualifications: 5+ years of Securities Operations experience, or equivalent experience demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education 2+ years of leadership experience 5+ years of experience in securities operations, brokerage operations, trade processing, middle office, investment operations or a closely related financial-services environment. People-management experience with demonstrated ability to lead multiple operational teams and/or frontline managers . Strong understanding of the securities trade lifecycle , including trade allocation, settlement, exception and break management. Experience managing time-sensitive and risk-sensitive operations within a strong control framework. Proven ability to manage complex business and operational escalations and make sound decisions under tight timelines. Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, quality management and issue remediation. Demonstrated experience working across global teams and managing senior stakeholder relationships. Proven track record of driving process improvement, automation, transformation or operational-efficiency initiatives . Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and influencing skills.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. The company EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and, a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 9 countries and 20 cities, GDS s dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and cutting-edge technology to enhance EYs wide array of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Join us at EY GDS Hungary to shape your future with confidence. The opportunity Join our dynamic Global Payroll Operations team and play a vital role in driving the success of our expanding Global Reporting, Payments, and Regulatory initiatives! Your contributions will be essential in shaping our future and enhancing our global impact. Our Global Payroll Operate practice focuses on helping our clients effectively manage their global payroll needs proactively and responsibly in 150+ countries. Our quality service and technical network enable you to help clients transform their global payroll functions, by reducing inefficiencies, mitigating risk and driving process improvement across the payroll functions. We believe that by managing clients payroll obligations, we can make a critical difference, and you ll be at the heart of this mission. 
 
 Our market-leading approach combines extensive local payroll service experience with a standard global payroll compliance and implementation methodology. With engagements involving a few countries or many, you will have the opportunity to provide clients with an integrated, consistent, quality service that unlocks the potential of the payroll function across the entire process. The Global Reporting, Payments and Regulatory team is dedicated to excelling in the delivery of innovative payroll reporting technology solutions (DigiPay Cloud and PCC Global Reporting) that not only meet but exceed global standards and cater to specific client requirements. We are committed to developing a standardized General Ledger (GL) solution alongside a robust, customized GL offering. The team manages payroll regulatory tasks and contributes to payment solution developments. Job purpose : The purpose of this role is to facilitate the implementation of global reporting and support ongoing General Ledger delivery activities while ensuring effective coordination among internal teams. Additionally, the position serves as a subject matter expert in payroll regulations, gathering and analyzing data to drive process improvements and enhance business development initiatives. Your key responsibilities Client-Facing Activities : Support for implementation of global reporting. Support for BAU General Ledger delivery activities. Internal Coordination Activities : Coordination of global reporting best practices and methodologies with internal teams (e.g., Client Operations teams regarding sales, Tech Operations teams for implementation, and Learning and Development teams for training design). Project management support and participation in business development initiatives. Change management activities related to process improvements. Regulatory Expertise (Subject Matter Expert) : Gathering payroll regulatory data from Country Payroll Processing teams, analyzing it, and ensuring regular updates. Maintaining communication with Country Payroll Processing teams. Providing data for the PKA (global payroll chatbot) and Ebury PCubed (payment solution service development) Leadership & Delivery 7+ years of payroll transformation, payroll operations, and delivery experience Multi-country payroll implementation experience (APAC, EMEA, ANZ, Africa) Payroll Technology Payroll technology consulting and delivery experience Exposure to CIPP for one or more countries (optional) SuccessFactors and Workday integrations Payroll solution architecture, data migration, and systems integration UAT, testing, and production support Payroll operating model design Payroll modernization, automation, and AI adoption Process Excellence Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies (optional) Automation and transformation initiatives (payroll and Tax domain) Process standardization and optimization (payroll and tax) Additional Qualifications and experience Advanced Excel Skills : Proficient in analyzing large datasets and creating pivot tables. Payroll Service Knowledge : Familiarity with G2N (Gross to Net) reports and pay codes. General Ledger (GL) Expertise: Understanding of General Ledger . DigiPay Proficiency : Knowledge of DigiPay system. Synthesis Skills: Ability to comprehend incoming requests, translate them into actionable tasks, and communicate effectively with internal project teams. Project Management Skills : Experience in building trackers and following up on task lists with stakeholders. Organizational Skills : Highly structured and organized approach to work. Adaptability : Strong ability to adapt to changing environments and requirements. Additional skills and attributes for success Excel Macro Development Skills : Proficient in writing and implementing Excel macros to automate tasks and enhance efficiency. What we offer By seamlessly integrating with EY member firm teams across the globe, GDS contributes significantly to EYs purposeful and sustainable growth, delivering insights and solutions that foster trust in capital markets and create value for EY clients, society, and the planet. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling to deliver excellent results while allowing everyone to build your career without sacrificing personal priorities, providing: A competitive salary and benefits package, including private health insurance. Opportunities for professional development and career growth, by access to training and development programs, coaching and mentoring as well as on-the job opportunities. A supportive and collaborative work environment with multicultural teams. Flexible working hours and hybrid work with 2 days in the office per week. Employee wellness programs and initiatives and the opportunity to obtain the All You Can Move sport pass. Possibility to volunteer for meaningful initiatives to positively impact lives in the community. GDS is All in to shape the future with confidence, addressing todays challenges, and anticipating tomorrows needs. EY GDS is not just reimagining the future of work-its actively building it, ensuring agility, efficiency, and resilience in an ever-evolving world. EY | Building a better working world 
 
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 
 
 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 
 
 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Director, Business Execution Lead
description:
Job Summary The Chief Client Office engages customers and key stakeholders to drive commercial growth and create measurable value for S&P Global, strengthening client relationships and the overall client experience across the enterprise. The Chief Client Officer also serves as Co Head of Market Intelligence, with a mandate spanning Client Coverage, Enterprise Marketing, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships, Kensho Data & Platforms, and functions including Legal, COO, and Client Experience (CX) with alignment across enterprise Technology. The Impact: The Business Execution Lead keeps the Office's recurring work moving - gathering inputs and packaging the Weekly Briefing Pack and Analytics packs for the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence, coordinating executive readiness for meetings and events, and responding to ad hoc requests and priority initiatives. This hands-on role gives the Chief of Staff reliable, high-quality execution support and helps the Office run smoothly in a fast-paced, complex environment. Key Responsibilities Own the Weekly Briefing Pack and the Chief Client Office and Market Intelligence Weekly Analytics packs end-to-end - gathering inputs, compiling and quality controlling materials, and driving continuous improvement. Build a clear, forward-looking view of the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence's week - meetings, objectives, context, and preparation needs. Translate priorities into clear work plans, milestones, and timelines, driving multiple workstreams simultaneously and building trusted working relationships across the Chief Client Office, Market Intelligence, Kensho Data & Platforms, and other stakeholders - setting clear expectations for quality, timing, and follow-through, and escalating early with clear context, options, and a recommended path forward on matters requiring strategic judgment or sensitive stakeholder management. Coordinate readiness for client meetings, speaking engagements, conferences, and leadership events wherever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling - including London, New York, and other locations - partnering with local offices, the Executive Assistant, and relevant business and functional teams to ensure briefing materials clearly set out context, objectives, stakeholders, decisions required, and expected outcomes. Own the Office Stakeholder Matrix and maintain Office calendars, action trackers, and decision logs, giving stakeholders clear visibility into priorities, status, and outstanding requirements. Support Chief of Staff-led OpCo meetings, leadership forums, and offsites as requested - including readiness, materials, and action tracking - with increasing ownership as experience grows. Continuously improve recurring deliverables and office workflows, building repeatable processes and templates that reduce manual effort and improve consistency and scalability. Use AI and automation tools approved by S&P Global to support information gathering, summarization, content development, and quality checking, maintaining sound judgment, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable S&P Global requirements. Respond to ad hoc executive requests and support selected cross-functional priority initiatives. What We're Looking For Experience in financial services is strongly preferred, ideally in a client-facing role involving significant interaction with institutional clients and senior stakeholders. Proven experience driving execution in an executive office, Chief of Staff organization, PMO, business operations team, or similarly complex environment, with a demonstrated ability to navigate across functions, businesses, geographies, and levels of seniority to build alignment and get things done. Demonstrated ability to own recurring executive deliverables end-to-end and produce complete, accurate, executive-ready materials. Strong ability to assimilate information, synthesize key themes, identify gaps, and translate fragmented inputs into clear materials. Excellent project coordination, organization, written communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, meet tight timelines, and maintain attention to detail. Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and executive level matters. Comfortable navigating sensitive or difficult topics with stakeholders at all levels, exercising tact, diplomacy, and sound judgment while maintaining trust and confidentiality. Experience with Microsoft 365 and AI productivity and workflow automation tools. A continuous-improvement mindset, strong personal accountability, and a commitment to proactive communication and follow-through. Expected to be in the office whenever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is in the office and to comply with the applicable S&P Global in-office attendance policy. What Success Looks Like Executive deliverables are complete, accurate, timely, forward-looking, and ready for use. Stakeholders are engaged, routine issues are resolved promptly, and strategic matters are escalated early with clear recommendations. Executive engagements and events are consistently well prepared across London, New York, and other locations where the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling. Commitments, deadlines, dependencies, decisions, and risks remain visible and are followed through to completion. Approved technology and AI tools reduce manual effort and improve consistency without compromising judgment, confidentiality, or accuracy.

title: Consultant Supply Chain Analytics
description:
Consultant Supply Chain Analytics Description - Join the Analytics organization at HP Inc. and play a key role in supporting large-scale supply chain transformation and digital initiatives through advanced data analysis and actionable business insights. The Data Analyst will collect, integrate, analyze, and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, data quality gaps, process issues, and improvement opportunities. The role will partner with Supply Chain, Business, IT, and external stakeholders to translate business requirements into analytical solutions, dashboards, KPIs, and data-driven recommendations. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL, Python, data visualization, data quality, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities with an understanding of supply chain processes and experience working in complex transformation environments. 
 Key Responsibilities Data Analysis & Insights Analyze large and complex datasets using SQL, Python, Excel, and other analytical tools to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business opportunities. Translate complex business problems and supply chain requirements into structured analytical approaches and actionable insights. Perform root-cause, variance, and exploratory analysis to identify drivers behind data quality, operational, planning, and process issues. Develop analytical models, metrics, and data-driven recommendations to support business and operational decision-making. Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis across multiple data sources and systems. Identify gaps in data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness and collaborate with business and technology teams to drive resolution. Analyze supply chain data across demand, supply, inventory, product, supplier, BOM/master data, and transactional data. Automate recurring data analysis, validation, reporting, and monitoring activities using SQL, Python, or related technologies. Business Intelligence, Reporting & Visualization Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and analytical reports using Power BI or Tableau. Convert complex data into clear visualizations and executive-ready insights that enable timely business decisions. Establish scalable metrics and reporting solutions to track data quality, operational performance, trends, and transformation outcomes. Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, business rules, and data definitions. Data Management & Digital Transformation Work with structured data from multiple enterprise systems and support data extraction, transformation, integration, and reconciliation activities. Understand data flows and dependencies across source systems, data platforms, analytical layers, and downstream reporting solutions. Support enterprise digital transformation initiatives involving SAP platforms such as ARIBA, BTP, IBP, and EBW. Participate in solution design, requirements validation, testing, UAT, and deployment of data and analytics solutions. Contribute to advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and intelligent automation opportunities where applicable. Supply Chain & Business Partnership Support analytics for Supply Chain Planning, including demand and supply planning, product availability, inventory, and operational performance. Partner with Supply Chain, Business, IT, Analytics, and external teams to investigate data and process issues and translate findings into business actions. Support large-scale supply chain transformation programs through data analysis, KPI tracking, testing, issue resolution, and decision-support analytics. Communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Manage multiple analytical assignments and deliverables in a global, cross-functional environment. 
 Skills & Competencies Core Data Analytics Skills Strong hands-on experience with SQL for querying, joining, aggregating, and analyzing large datasets. Proficiency in Python for data analysis, manipulation, validation, and automation. Strong experience with Power BI and/or Tableau for dashboard development and data visualization. Experience performing root-cause, trend, variance, and exploratory analysis. Strong understanding of data quality principles, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and reconciliation. Experience with data modeling, data transformation, ETL concepts, and data integration. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and rapid business investigation. Ability to convert ambiguous business problems into data requirements, analytical logic, metrics, and insights. Supply Chain & Business Skills Understanding of supply chain, planning, inventory, procurement, manufacturing, supplier, or operations processes. Experience analyzing supply chain and operational datasets is strongly preferred. Exposure to ERP and enterprise data environments, with SAP knowledge preferred. Ability to communicate analytical findings through business narratives, dashboards, and executive presentations. Experience working in Agile and cross-functional environments; familiarity with JIRA and TestRail is desirable. Strong stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and attention to detail. Exposure to machine learning, Generative AI, or advanced analytics is desirable. 
 Qualifications & Experience 4-8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business analytics, supply chain analytics, operations analytics, business intelligence, or related roles. Demonstrated hands-on experience with SQL, data visualization/BI tools, and large datasets. Experience using Python for analytics or automation is strongly preferred. Experience in supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, or operations analytics is preferred. Experience supporting large-scale digital or supply chain transformation initiatives is an advantage. Bachelor s or Bachelor s + Masters degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Data Analytics, or cloud/data technologies are advantageous.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Executive Accounts Payable to manage day-to-day Accounts Payable operations, including invoice processing, vendor reconciliation, payment processing, and accounting entries. The ideal candidate should have experience in a high-volume environment and be comfortable working with cross-functional teams such as Procurement, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Commercial, and Finance. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 Accounts Payable Operations : Handle end-to-end Accounts Payable processes, from invoice receipt to payment. Process and verify vendor invoices accurately and within defined timelines. Perform PO, GRN, and invoice matching and identify discrepancies. Ensure timely booking of invoices and accounting entries. Track invoice status, pending approvals, and payment due dates. Maintain and monitor AP ageing and ensure timely closure of outstanding items. 
 Vendor Management Handle vendor queries related to invoices, payments, deductions, and outstanding balances. Perform regular vendor reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve invoice and payment-related issues. Maintain accurate vendor records and supporting documentation. 
 Compliance & Accounting Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, and company accounting policies. • Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Assist with internal, statutory, and tax audits by providing required documents and reconciliations. Ensure proper documentation and adherence to internal financial controls. 
 MIS & Reporting Prepare AP ageing, vendor outstanding, payment, and reconciliation reports. Track pending invoices and payment commitments. Provide regular AP-related MIS to the Finance Manager. Identify discrepancies and support corrective actions. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and reduce invoice processing TAT. Support AP automation and ERP process improvements. Ensure adherence to defined SOPs and internal controls. 


 Preferred candidate profile 
 3 to 8 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable / P2P. Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field (B.Com preferred). Experience handling a high volume of invoices and vendors. Strong understanding of PO, GRN, invoice processing, and vendor reconciliation. Good working knowledge of GST and TDS. Prior experience in Beauty & Personal Care, FMCG, D2C, Retail, or E-commerce will be an advantage. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Good command of MS Excel.

Key Skills: Vendor reconciliation,Senior,Vendor,Payment processing,Payments,Payables,Invoicing,Invoice verification

description:
City Operations Manager - 30 Premium Gyms, Delhi NCR - WTF Gyms About WTF 
WTF Gyms runs 60 premium gyms of its own across Delhi NCR plus ~200 partner gyms (WTF Powered), with 85,000+ members. A premium gym runs 16-18 hours a day. Members judge us every hour on clean washrooms, working machines, cool air and a trainer on the floor. For executors who run service operations across many sites today - gym, quick-commerce, home services, retail, QSR or hotel chains. Not for single-gym, desk-MIS or sales roles. What you own How 30 WTF gyms run and feel, every day: equipment uptime, cleanliness and hygiene, staffing at peak hours, member NPS and complaint SLAs. Unannounced weekly audits of every gym with photo proof, through 2 Ops Associates. Every gap closed with an owner and a date - a recovery plan, not a status update. Rosters and design-number staffing for front desk, trainers and housekeeping, a floater bench, attendance and attrition, all with HR. Every member-felt fault (AC, washroom, showers, machines) fixed the same day with our Facility team and vendors; repeat faults removed. Trainer and front-desk quality through mystery audits, grooming and onboarding checks. Re-training with L&D; re-train twice, then exit. New gym openings in your city: readiness checklist, launch on the date, and the first 30 days stabilised. Vendor scorecards: housekeeping, security, pest, AMC. A daily ops dashboard by 10 am and the weekly Ops Review with Area Managers. You build the tracker yourself. Who fits 6-10 years in multi-site service ops, with 3+ years owning 15-30+ sites. Typical backgrounds: Urban Company Category / Senior Category Manager; Zypp, Blinkit or Zepto Cluster or City ops; Cult.fit Cluster Manager; Lenskart Area Ops Manager; Licious Store Director to Area; hotel Duty or Front Office Manager moving into multi-site work. You can quote the numbers you moved: before to after, how many sites, how many months. On the ground 5 days a week, including 6 am and 9 pm peaks and weekends. Builds your own dashboards in Excel or Sheets; SQL or Metabase is a plus. title: Content Writing & Copywriting Intern
description:
Content Writing Copywriting Intern - SEO, Ads Scripts We are looking for a curious writer who can understand a marketing brief and turn it into clear, useful content. You will work with our marketing, SEO and creative teams on scripts, ad copy and search-focused content for brands and websites. In-office, Delhi. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Write short video/Reel scripts, opening hooks, on-screen text and clear calls to action. Develop ad-copy variations, headlines, landing-page copy and social captions for different audiences and offers. Write and edit SEO articles, introductions, page copy, titles, meta descriptions and heading outlines that match search intent. Research a topic, check facts, work from approved product information and avoid unsupported claims. Improve drafts using feedback, maintain a consistent brand voice and explain why a line or angle fits the brief. Collaborate with designers, marketers and SEO colleagues and keep drafts organised in Google Docs or similar tools. 
 
 Requirements 
 Clear English writing, sound grammar, editing ability and attention to detail. Understanding of audience, benefits, hooks, offers and calls to action. Practical SEO basics: search intent, natural keyword use, useful headings, metadata and helpful content. Some exposure to digital marketing through an internship, college project, freelance work, a personal page/blog or a writing portfolio. Strong beginners can apply; no previous full-time job is required. Ability to accept feedback and revise your own work. Hinglish writing is useful for some campaigns, but optional. Availability for an in-office internship in Wazirpur/Shalimar Bagh, Delhi. Share your current locality, commute/relocation plan and college or other scheduling commitments. 
 
 How to Apply 
 Share your CV and two or three writing samples, ideally one SEO article/page and one ad or script. Personal or college samples are welcome. For each, explain the audience, objective and your own contribution. Use public or view-access links and do not share confidential client work. If you have no portfolio, you may submit a short self-created sample and label it clearly. 
 
 Selection Process 
 Portfolio review A 45-60-minute fictional writing exercise A brief live discussion/rewrite The exercise tests ad/script writing, SEO content, editing, factual accuracy and reasoning. No real client work is requested or used. AI and research tools may be used with disclosure; you must be able to explain and revise the final work.

title: Accounts And Finance Manager
description:
JOB TITLE: Finance cum Accounts Manager Industry: Retail & Distribution
 Location: Bangalore
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Reporting To: CFO / Director Finance / Managing Director
 Experience Required: 58 Years 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Finance cum Accounts Manager to lead the end-to-end finance and accounting operations of our retail and distribution business. The candidate will be responsible for financial reporting, statutory compliance, GST and taxation, working capital management, budgeting, audits, MIS reporting, banking operations, and internal financial controls. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Indian accounting and taxation laws, experience managing multi-location accounts, and the ability to develop financial processes that support business growth. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries and bank reconciliations. Maintain accurate books of accounts as per applicable Indian Accounting Standards and the Companies Act, 2013. Manage month-end and year-end financial closures. Prepare and finalize Trial Balance, Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets. Oversee inventory accounting, fixed assets and depreciation. Manage inter-branch and inter-warehouse reconciliations. 2. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance Ensure timely GST filings, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual returns. Handle GST reconciliations, ITC management, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS, TCS, advance tax payments and Income Tax returns. Handle ROC filings and applicable Companies Act compliances. Ensure compliance with EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable labour laws. Manage MSME compliance and vendor payment requirements. Handle FEMA, RBI and customs-related compliance wherever applicable. Ensure applicable state-level business and operational statutory compliances. Independently coordinate and respond to statutory and tax notices. 3. MIS & Management Reporting Develop and maintain daily, weekly, monthly and annual MIS reports. Prepare store-wise, SKU-wise, category-wise and channel-wise sales reports. Monitor gross margins, contribution margins, EBITDA and operating expenses. Track inventory ageing, slow-moving stock and stock turnover. Prepare debtor and creditor ageing reports. Monitor working capital and cash flow. Prepare budget versus actual reports and variance analysis. Develop financial dashboards using Power BI, Tableau or Zoho Analytics. 4. Working Capital, Treasury & Banking Manage cash flow forecasting and working capital requirements. Monitor receivables, collections and distributor/dealer credit limits. Oversee vendor payments and payable management. Coordinate with banks for CC/OD limits, stock statements and drawing power. Manage banking relationships, fund transfers and financial documentation. Handle bank guarantees and letters of credit wherever applicable. 5. Budgeting & Business Finance Lead annual budgeting across stores, warehouses and corporate functions. Work with sales, procurement and operations teams to monitor financial performance. Analyse margins, discounts, schemes and trade promotion expenses. Provide financial inputs for new store openings and business expansion. Support management in pricing, cost optimisation and commercial decision-making. 6. Audit & Internal Controls Coordinate statutory, internal, tax, GST and bank audits. Develop and implement financial SOPs and internal control systems. Establish controls for cash handling, inventory, vendor onboarding and reconciliations. Ensure proper documentation and audit readiness. Identify financial risks and recommend process improvements. 7. Team Management Lead and supervise the accounts and finance team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance. Train and mentor junior accountants and accounts executives. Ensure timely completion of accounting and compliance activities. 
 Required Qualifications CA / CMA / MBA in Finance. CA preferred. Inter-CA candidates with strong relevant retail experience may also be considered. 58 years of relevant professional experience. Minimum 4 years of experience in retail, FMCG distribution, trading or multi-location businesses. Strong knowledge of Indian accounting standards, GST, TDS, Income Tax and Companies Act. Experience managing accounts across multiple branches, stores or warehouses. 
 Technical Skills Required Tally Prime SAP Business One / Oracle NetSuite / MS Dynamics Advanced MS Excel Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP and Power Query Power BI / Tableau / Zoho Analytics GST and TDS compliance Financial reporting and MIS preparation Budgeting and financial forecasting 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong financial and accounting knowledge. Excellent analytical and numerical skills. Strong understanding of taxation and statutory compliance. Ability to independently manage financial operations. Experience in developing MIS reports and financial dashboards. Strong leadership and team management skills. Good communication and coordination skills. High attention to detail, integrity and confidentiality. 
 Preferred Industry Experience Retail, FMCG, Distribution, Wholesale Trading, Consumer Goods and Multi-location Business Operations.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
Senior Technical Account Manager Location: Bengaluru (Work from Office) Experience: 8-10 years Reports to: Head of Customer Success About Mojro At Mojro, we don t just optimize logistics - we reimagine it. We are a deep-tech logistics optimization company helping some of the world s largest FMCG, Paints, CEP and Retail enterprises simplify complex logistics challenges. Our platforms - PlanWyse (route and load optimization) and ExecuteWyse (real-time execution monitoring) - reduce transportation costs, raise service levels and power smarter, faster decisions for customers such as Unilever, Asian Paints, Berger and Godrej. The role You will own the technical success of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, from first kickoff to steady-state operations. You design and deliver the implementation, own the integrations, take customers live, and remain their primary technical authority after go-live. You are also the person who can explain why the optimization engine produced a given plan - and what to change when the plan isn t right. This role suits someone who has implemented a complex, decision-heavy SaaS product - a TMS or routing platform, or a supply chain planning, inventory or scheduling tool - and wants end-to-end ownership rather than a single slice of the lifecycle. You will also lead Mojro s Customer Success Engineering (CSE) team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you remain the team s strongest troubleshooter, not only its manager. What you will do 1. Implementation and solution design Lead implementations end to end: discovery, scoping, solution design, configuration, integration, testing and go-live. Author and own SOWs, Functional and Technical Design Documents (FDD/TDD), workflow diagrams and architecture specifications. Translate customer business rules - fleet, time windows, capacities, service levels, costs - into a working solution configuration. 2. Integrations and technical delivery Own integrations with customer ERP, WMS, OMS and other systems via API, webhook and FTP/SFTP. Perform data mapping, environment setup and interface validation. Debug issues hands-on using SQL, Postman, logs and browser developer tools. 3. UAT and go-live Plan and run User Acceptance Testing with customers; drive defect triage with Product and Engineering to closure. Prepare go-live plans, risk assessments, cutover checklists and hypercare. 4. Technical account ownership after go-live Act as the primary technical contact for live accounts, alongside the Customer Success Manager. Run proactive technical health checks, usage reviews and periodic technical reviews with customer teams. Resolve complex product and integration issues, involving L3 Engineering only when needed. Identify technical expansion opportunities and support CS on renewals, upsells and cross-sells. 5. Optimization and plan quality Diagnose plan-quality issues: unassigned orders, capacity or time-window violations, cost or utilization outliers. Tune constraints and parameters with customers, and explain trade-offs in business terms. Feed patterns back to Product to improve the engine and its defaults. 6. Product feedback Surface product gaps, missing APIs and enhancement needs from implementations and live accounts. Work with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support prioritization. 7. Leadership and team enablement Lead and manage the CSE team: hiring, goals, performance reviews and development. Act as the team s technical escalation point, stepping in personally on the hardest integration and production issues. Review solution designs and integration approaches before every go-live. Prioritize technical issues across concurrent implementations and allocate the team accordingly. Mentor engineers on integration debugging, troubleshooting, documentation and customer communication. Own the team s implementation standards, deployment templates, playbooks and knowledge-base content. Support Sales and Pre-Sales with technical scoping and feasibility for complex deals. What you bring Must have 8-10 years in B2B SaaS implementation, technical account management, customer success engineering or solutions consulting for a complex enterprise product. Background in either : (a) logistics, TMS, routing or visibility platforms; or (b) optimization or planning software - supply chain planning, inventory, demand, scheduling or similar. Experience leading a team of engineers or consultants while staying hands-on yourself. Hands-on SQL, REST APIs, Postman and log interpretation; you still debug integrations yourself. Proven experience writing SOWs, FDDs/TDDs and workflow or architecture documentation. Experience owning customer accounts after go-live, not only through implementation. Ability to run several enterprise projects at once with strong project discipline. Clear communication with both customer IT and operations or business stakeholders. Good to have Exposure to optimization concepts: constraints, objective functions, heuristics or solvers. Familiarity with Jira, HubSpot and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau). Knowledge of authentication flows (SSO, OAuth, MFA) and cloud deployment basics. Education Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, IT or a related field; equivalent depth of SaaS implementation experience will be considered. 
 What success looks like in your first year You have taken at least two enterprise accounts live as the technical owner. Your live accounts run with stable integrations and few repeat escalations. Customers trust you to explain and improve plan quality without needing Engineering in the room. Your CSE team resolves most escalations without you, and works to standards and playbooks you set.

title: Senior Analyst, Learning - Continuous Listening
description:
Role Purpose Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise Learning Applications, while also providing technical application and integration leadership for the Continuous Listening platform. The role is primarily accountable for the global learning technology portfolio, including Cornerstone OnDemand adjacent learning platforms and application rationalization. It also owns the technical enablement of Continuous Listening on Qualtrics, with emphasis on integrations, data flows, identity and access, security, releases and production support. This role combines program management, stakeholder leadership and application ownership. It translates business priorities into governed roadmaps, coordinates cross-functional delivery, manages vendors and ensures solutions are scalable, secure, supportable and aligned with Schneider Digital architecture. Scope and Impact Primary responsibility for global Learning Applications serving employees, partners, customers and other learning populations. Technical and integration responsibility for the global Continuous Listening platform and its connected HR data and reporting ecosystem. Leadership of multi-region programs, releases, pilots, upgrades, integrations, migrations, application lifecycle decisions and operational improvements. Senior stakeholder interface across Global HR COEs, business leaders, Schneider Digital, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement, regional teams and strategic vendors. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Define and deliver the learning technology roadmap aligned with enterprise HR and Schneider Digital strategy. Own the application lifecycle for Cornerstone OnDemand and connected learning platforms, including roadmap, releases, upgrades, feature enablement, service performance and lifecycle decisions. Program-manage the transition to Learn / Single Architecture and selected Learn+ capabilities, coordinating environment readiness, configuration integrations, UAT, cutover, hypercare and stabilization. Coordinate learning integrations across HR master data, identity and access, skills, content providers, analytics and data platforms, collaboration tools and external learning audiences. Lead portfolio rationalization, supporting retain, integrate, consolidate, replace and retire decisions across global and regional learning applications. Coordinate responsible-AI, data, content, privacy, cybersecurity and production-readiness governance for AI-enabled learning capabilities. Drive adoption and measurable value across discoverability, learner engagement, time to competence, administration efficiency, platform reliability and workforce readiness. Own the technical application lifecycle and roadmap for the Qualtrics Continuous Listening platform, including environments, configuration governance, releases, vendor changes and transition to steady-state support. Lead integration design and delivery across HR source systems, employee and organizational data, identity and access management, SSO, APIs, middleware, secure file transfers, survey distribution processes, dashboards and approved downstream analytics. Define and govern interface specifications, data mapping, transformation rules, scheduling, reconciliation, monitoring, error handling and support ownership for end-to-end data flows. Coordinate technical readiness for survey waves and dashboards, including population and hierarchy validation, role-based access, anonymity and confidentiality controls, testing, deployment, hypercare and rollback planning. Ensure controls for privileged access, personal and employee-experience data, retention, encryption, audit logging, third-party security, privacy reviews, application certification and remediation evidence. Lead incident and problem management for platform, integration, data-quality and reporting issues, including root-cause analysis, vendor escalation and corrective-action tracking. Maintain solution architecture, integration inventory, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, access models, environment strategy, release calendar, runbooks and operational documentation. Translate listening, survey and dashboard requirements into scalable technical designs and clearly communicate feasibility, constraints, dependencies and risks to business stakeholders. Provide technical governance for platform enhancements and AI-enabled listening use cases before production release. Lead end-to-end delivery from intake and discovery through planning, execution, UAT, launch, stabilization and benefits realization. Build integrated plans covering scope, milestones, stage gates, resources, financials, RAID, dependencies, change, adoption, vendor deliverables and operational handover. Run steering reviews, decision forums, executive reporting, escalation management and cross-functional delivery cadences. Establish clear readiness and go/no-go criteria covering business, technical, data, security, privacy, support and change readiness. Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban and enterprise stage-gate practices based on initiative needs. Serve as a senior technology partner to Learning, Employee Listening and HR COEs, translating priorities into executable digital roadmaps. Facilitate requirements, prioritization and trade-off decisions among business owners, regions, technical teams and vendors. Prepare executive-ready status reports, decision papers, recommendations and QBR materials. Drive structured change, communications, administrator enablement, user readiness and adoption measurement. Hold Cornerstone, Qualtrics and service partners accountable for technical deliverables, issue resolution, roadmap commitments and SLA performance. Support renewals, SOWs, license planning, commercial assessments, forecasts and benefits reporting. Ensure clean transition to operations with defined L1/L2/L3 ownership, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths and service reviews. Drive incident reduction, change success, integration reliability, data quality and mean time to restore. Ensure architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, data-protection, accessibility and production-readiness requirements are completed before release. Promote reusable technical standards, integration patterns, delivery checklists, governance templates and lessons learned. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 Required 
 Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, HR Technology, Learning Technologies or a related field. 8 to 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise applications, HR technology or digital transformation, including at least 3 years leading global or multi-region initiatives. Strong experience with enterprise learning platforms such as Cornerstone OnDemand, including application lifecycle, releases, integrations and production support. Technical application or integration experience with survey and employee-experience platforms such as Qualtrics. Hands-on experience defining or governing integrations using APIs, SSO/SAML, secure file transfer, middleware/connectors, HR data feeds, organizational hierarchies and analytics or dashboard data flows. Experience with UAT, cutover, hypercare, release management, operational handover, incident/problem management and vendor-led technical delivery. Demonstrated stakeholder-management experience across senior HR, business, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement and vendor organizations. Strong understanding of SaaS security, access controls, data privacy, application certification, audit evidence and service management. Excellent program management, executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and structured problem-solving skills. 
 
 Preferred Certifications 
 PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner. Agile Scrum Master or SAFe certification. ITIL 4 Foundation or higher. Cornerstone OnDemand Administrator or relevant vendor certification. Qualtrics platform or integration training/certification. Azure Integration Services, API management, Power BI, data fundamentals or AI-focused certification. 
 
 Success Metrics 
 On-time and on-budget delivery of learning and Continuous Listening technology roadmap commitments. Successful Learn / Learn+ releases against technical readiness, UAT, cutover, security and stabilization criteria. Reliable Qualtrics integrations, accurate survey populations and hierarchies, stable dashboard data flows and successful production releases. Platform stability, SLA achievement, change success, incident reduction and improved MTTR. Integration reliability and data quality across Learning, HR, identity, listening, content and analytics ecosystems. Strong stakeholder confidence, timely decisions, transparent risks and effective vendor performance. Compliance performance, including privacy, privileged access, security remediation, certification and audit readiness. Adoption, operational efficiency, platform simplification and measurable business outcomes. 
 
 Working Model 
 Global stakeholder coverage with flexibility to support key time zones. Matrixed delivery through application owners, integration and data teams, architecture, security, privacy, business owners and strategic vendors. Occasional travel for program workshops, technical design sessions, vendor reviews and stakeholder engagements.

 We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Voyage Performance Analyst with a strong marine background to support vessel voyage monitoring, performance analysis, and operational optimization. The role involves analyzing vessel performance data, monitoring KPIs, managing voyage efficiency initiatives, and providing fact-based recommendations to improve operational and fuel performance across the fleet. Demonstrate willingness to take ownership of assigned projects and adapt to new challenges. Contribute to daily departmental activities and support service delivery requirements.

 Required Qualifications
