title: Senior Director Finance
description:
Sr Director, Assistant Controller 
 Title: Sr Director- Assistant Controller Location: Hyderabad Work from Office : 4 days ( Mon- Thrus) 
 Shift : 5 PM 2AM 
 Who We Are 
 Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the worlds leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes. Were an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it. 
 Our Values 
 Customers We relentlessly increase value for customers and do the right thing for them. Action We make thoughtfully fast decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability. Team Spirit We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together. Innovation We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create. Excellence We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger. 
 About the Role 
 The Sr Director, Assistant Controller is a critical role responsible for all aspects of the daily accounting teams operations, including general ledger, AP, AR, intercompany, consolidations, month-end close, internal controls, technical accounting, and the external audit. You will leverage AI tools and co-worker agents to define how the accounting function scales driving close efficiency, strengthening controls, and elevating the quality of financial reporting across the organization. This senior leadership role requires a CPA with deep public company experience and a track record of building and leading high-performing accounting organizations. You will work closely with the VP, Corporate Controller, shape accounting policy, drive continuous improvement, and serve as a strategic finance partner across the Billtrust ecosystem. 
 What Youll Do 
 Accounting Operations & Close Provide direct oversight of the general ledger, including detailed review of balance sheet and income statement reconciliations, journal entries, and analytics. Oversee the accounts receivable, accounts payable, P2P, and invoice-to-cash processes, including proper application of controls. Prepare information required for internal management, monthly, and quarterly reporting. Drive the execution of reductions in time to produce accurate month-end closes. Define how AI transforms the close process — from reconciliation automation to cash forecasting support. Other duties as assigned. 
 Technical Accounting, Audit & Controls 
 Provide technical accounting support by developing analyses, performing research, and preparing/reviewing memos supporting the company’s conclusions. Design, implement, and enhance internal controls that ensure compliance and clean integrated audits. Assist the VP, Corporate Controller with all external audit activities; ensure all audit issues are resolved and annual financial statements comply with US GAAP. Maintain and uphold consistent accounting policies, practices, and procedures across the organization. Team Leadership & Strategic Impact 
 Hire, train, and retain a skilled team of accounting managers and staff to continue building a best-in-class accounting organization. Proactively lead continuous improvement initiatives by building scalable, repeatable processes and operational strategies. Establish and monitor key performance metrics for the accounting department. Champion AI-first culture across the accounting function, setting AI strategy and embedding tools into daily workflows. Collaborate across Finance and Talent to support FP&A, payroll, tax, treasury, and equity functions. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Required Skills: 15+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 7+ years as an accounting senior manager or above at publicly traded companies. Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Accounting. CPA license or equivalent experience. Extensive technical accounting knowledge of ASC 606, 842, and 718; broad knowledge of US GAAP. Superior written and verbal communication skills and strong interpersonal skills. 6+ years of experience leading accounting teams of at least 20 people. Experience setting AI strategy and championing an AI-first culture at scale within an accounting function. 
 Preferred Skills: 
 SaaS-based experience at companies with revenues exceeding $250 million. Experience with international expansion. Demonstrated track record using AI to transform accounting operations and close cycle times. Experience with accounting system implementations and process redesign at scale. 
 What You’ll Get 
 At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it. At Billtrust, we value an equitable and inclusive work environment and strive to build and foster diverse teams. Even if your work experience doesn’t align exactly with the position requirements, we’d still love to hear from you. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that celebrates and supports diversity and inclusion. We make all employment and related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

As we expand our retail presence, we are looking for a proactive and hands-on HR professional who can build and manage our HR function, establish strong people systems and create a positive, disciplined and performance-driven work culture. Role Objective To independently manage the complete HR function at Gambol, covering recruitment, employee management, attendance, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, training, performance management and employee engagement. The candidate will be responsible for creating structured HR processes that support our growing team and future expansion. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment for retail stores, warehouse and office positions. Understand manpower requirements from store managers and management. Source candidates through job portals, references, consultants and other channels. Conduct initial interviews and coordinate final selection. Maintain a recruitment tracker and ensure timely hiring. Build a database of potential retail talent for future expansion. 2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Management Manage employee attendance through HRMS / Jibble or similar software. Monitor daily attendance, late arrivals, absenteeism and overtime. Implement and manage leave policies and approval systems. Coordinate monthly payroll preparation with the accounts team. Employee Management & HR Operations Handle employee grievances, workplace issues and disciplinary matters. Act as the first point of contact for employee-related concerns. Develop and implement HR policies and SOPs. Manage employee onboarding, induction, transfers, confirmations and exits. Conduct regular employee interactions and feedback sessions. Define KPIs for sales staff, store managers, warehouse and support teams. Coordinate monthly and quarterly performance reviews. Monitor employee productivity, punctuality and discipline. Support incentive structures and employee recognition programmes. 6. Training & Development Organise induction and orientation programmes for new employees. Coordinate product knowledge and customer service training. Develop training programmes for sales staff and store managers. Identify skill gaps and arrange relevant training. Build a culture of learning, accountability and customer-first thinking. 7. Employee Engagement & Culture Plan employee engagement activities and celebrations. title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management
description:
Job Summary Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains. The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load. Role Overview About the team: Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSKs security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job. Key Responsibilities This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited - including telling a programme director that their review will not be. Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly. Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name. Develop the analyst teams domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two. Own the quality of what the practice produces - review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline - and correct it at the individual level when it drops. Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained. Manage the analyst teams day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms. Carry roughly a third of a reviewer caseload yourself on Tier 2 designs, so allocation decisions are informed by current technical judgement rather than administration. Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated. Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards. Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your teams ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSKs Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. Basic Qualifications 10+ years in cyber security or technology assurance, including team management - domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains Managing delivery across Principals and analysts - review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, using workflow automation Tracking findings to closure with throughput and turnaround metrics, and running practice governance reporting and audit evidence packs Carrying a review caseload alongside people management, coordinating with architecture, engineering and vendor delivery teams Managing AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and using AI to improve review throughput and evidence quality Managing AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and setting the evidence standard those reviews must meet. Preferred Qualifications Managing and developing a team of senior reviewers and analysts ServiceNow or equivalent GRC and workflow tooling, including automation and dashboards Enough architecture depth to personally carry a Tier 2 review of a SIEM integration or a cloud landing-zone design, so reviewer allocation is informed rather than administrative. Regulated industry experience, including GxP and audit evidence standards Protecting senior review capacity by absorbing day-to-day allocation and demand management into the delivery layer. Qualifications: Bachelors degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Typical tools and technologies: Review scheduling and reviewer allocation, workflow automation in ServiceNow, SLA, throughput and turnaround metrics, findings tracking to closure, governance reporting and audit evidence packs, Power BI. description:
About Cognizant Corporate Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth. At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. Could you be the one to make a difference.   About the role   As a  Manager , you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the  Internal Audit  team, collaborating with  Senior Managers, Associate Directors, Directors, AVP and VP stakeholders . You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve workflows while upholding our commitment to quality and continuous learning. As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact with our vibrant people and culture all while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.   In this role, you will:   Manage end-to-end execution of audit engagements, including planning, fieldwork, review, and reporting, ensuring alignment to risk areas and delivering value-added insights. Lead risk assessments, control evaluations, and identify opportunities to leverage data analytics by gaining a deep understanding of business processes, systems, and controls. Oversee activities with external/co-sourced auditors to ensure adequate audit coverage and improved efficiency and effectiveness. Drive alignment with audit teams and management on key findings, finalize audit reports, and ensure clarity on corrective action plans (MAPs). Ensure adherence to Internal Audit methodology, SOX requirements, documentation standards, and follow-up on implementation of management action plans. Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, and commit to continuous learning. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and impactful work.   What you must have to be considered   CA / CPA / CIA / MBA (Finance) / CFE or equivalent with relevant audit experience Strong knowledge of risk management frameworks (COSO), Internal Audit methodologies, SOX, and regulatory requirements such as the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act Experience in financial and operational audits with strong understanding of controls, systems, and processes Ability to provide well-developed solutions to audit findings and build credibility with stakeholders Strong capability to assess risk levels and partner with management on remediation plans Experience in stakeholder management and building strategic partnerships across internal and external teams Demonstration of high professional standards, integrity, and ethical behavior Strong ownership mindset with a focus on meaningful outcomes Embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, & Own It   These will help you succeed   Prior experience in the IT services industry Exposure to data analytics in audit engagements Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams Strong communication and presentation skills Continuous learning mindset with relevant certifications or training   Work model   We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a  hybrid position  requiring work a minimum of 3 days a week  at Cognizant office in Chennai  or  Bangalore location,  combined with remote work. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.   The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.   We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring.

title: Senior Manager - SAP Finance Solution Architect
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the worlds most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. This role owns the design and governance of Record-to-Report processes, financial controls, consolidation, statutory reporting, and global tax compliance capabilities. The position ensures financial transactions are accurately recorded, reported, and aligned with regulatory requirements across all jurisdictions. As a key steward of financial integrity within the digital core, the role enables transparent and reliable financial reporting. The leader supports transformation efforts by standardizing finance processes while balancing local compliance requirements. Their expertise is essential for protecting the companys financial governance framework and ensuring business confidence in financial data. Record-to-report solution architecture Own the end-to-end RTR design across the S/4HANA global template: Universal Journal, General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Intercompany, and Consolidation. Own the global enterprise structure and finance master data design - chart of accounts, company codes, ledgers, controlling areas, profit and cost center hierarchies, and reporting dimensions - with the discipline to keep it stable as segments and acquisitions are added. Design the financial close: period-end architecture, close task orchestration, intercompany reconciliation and elimination, foreign currency valuation, allocations, and close cycle time optimization. Own parallel accounting design across group and local GAAP requirements - ledger strategy, valuation approaches, and the treatment of statutory differences. Design product costing and margin analysis for a manufacturing and engineered-products environment, including standard costing, variance analysis, WIP, and service and project cost flows. Ensure finance design integrity across integration points - order-to-cash, source-to-pay, plan-to-manufacture, and project systems all post to your ledger, and the design has to hold at every one of those seams. 
 Global tax and statutory compliance Own the global tax architecture across indirect tax (VAT, GST, sales and use), withholding tax, and the tax determination logic embedded in transactional processes. Design and govern integration with tax engines and e-invoicing and e-reporting platforms, including country mandates for real-time and near-real-time reporting Own statutory and legal reporting design per country - local ledgers, statutory chart requirements, document numbering, audit file formats, and regulatory submissions. Maintain the localization roadmap across deployment waves, tracking mandate changes and ensuring the template absorbs them without fracturing. Partner with corporate tax, transfer pricing, and treasury on design decisions with financial and compliance consequence, and translate their requirements into system design rather than accepting them as configuration requests. Ensure finance controls and SOX requirements are designed in, working with the GRC architect so control evidence is produced by the system. 
 Template governance and delivery Act as the design authority for finance: approve or reject template deviations, hold the standardization line, and escalate rather than absorb when a segment pushes for local variation without statutory basis. Lead fit-to-standard workshops with global process owners and segment finance leadership, and drive process harmonization decisions to closure. Support deployment waves through localization design, testing strategy, cutover finance validation, opening balance verification, and hypercare defect resolution. Partner with the Data Migration and MDG leads on finance data - GL balances, open AR and AP, fixed assets, and cost object conversion - where accuracy is audited, not merely tested. Lead a team of finance functional architects and consultants, and hold system integrator delivery accountable for finance design quality. 
 Qualifications Required 15+ years in SAP finance, with at least 8 years in S/4HANA Finance and 5+ years as a solution architect on global programs. Deep expertise across S/4HANA Finance: Universal Journal, GL, Asset Accounting, Controlling, product costing, margin analysis, and Group Reporting or consolidation. Proven RTR solution ownership on at least two global S/4HANA implementations, including multi-country, multi-ledger, multi-currency design. Strong global tax and statutory compliance background - indirect tax determination, withholding tax, localization, and e-invoicing mandates across multiple regions. Demonstrated experience integrating an external tax engine (Vertex, OneSource, Avalara, or equivalent) and e-invoicing platforms. Accounting foundation - CA, CPA, MBA Finance, or equivalent - sufficient to hold a substantive conversation with a controller, not only with a consultant. Track record of defending a global finance template against local pressure, with the judgment to distinguish genuine statutory requirement from preference. Experience with financial close optimization and measurable close cycle reduction. 
 Preferred SAP Group Reporting, Central Finance, or BPC consolidation experience. SAP Analytics Cloud or Datasphere for financial planning and reporting. Treasury, in-house cash, or bank communication management. Project System and service cost accounting for an installed-base and aftermarket business. Manufacturing and engineered-products costing complexity: variant configuration, make-to-order, and long-cycle projects. Experience integrating acquisitions into a common finance template and chart of accounts. 
 Success in the First 12 Months A stable, documented finance template with an explicit and defended boundary between global standard and statutory local requirement. A localization roadmap covering upcoming waves and known mandate changes. Close cycle time baselined and improving in deployed entities. Finance controls designed in and evidenced automatically. Clean opening balances and audited conversion results in every wave. And finance design decisions made with speed and finality, so the program stops relitigating them. 
 Operating Principles You Will Work Under Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome. Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is governed at the point of creation. Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting. Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control integrity holds at deployment scale. Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized value, not tickets closed or hours delivered. Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible, are owned capabilities. Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy. 
 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Product Implementation Manager
description:
Job Summary The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade. The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth. In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization. What you ll be doing Portfolio Management Product Lifecycle Support Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership. Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance. Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products. Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities. Data Governance, Analytics Portfolio Optimization Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions. Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making. Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement. Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities. Strategic Portfolio Support Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans. Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions. Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations. Compliance, Quality Governance Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records. Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation. Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements. Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation. PPAP, Licensing Project Support Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities. Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support. Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable. Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance. Digital Enablement Continuous Improvement Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools. Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows. Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams. Stakeholder Collaboration Execution Support Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders. Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams. Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders. Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption. Leadership Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels) Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs. Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement. Support long-term capability development across the PIM community. Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise. Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams. What you bring A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage. Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements. Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.

title: EYP-SCM-Manager
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. GDS Strategy and Transactions - Manager - SCM In today s ultra-competitive and volatile business environment, business leaders are looking for strategic partners that can fluidly navigate between strategy and execution. EY-Parthenon has a market-leading proposition to create and maximize value for our clients, whether they are acquiring or divesting assets, or undertaking operational improvement/restructuring. EY-Parthenon s GDS Supply Chain (SCM) team works closely with our US Supply Chain Practice and clients to deliver value through the seamless execution of supply chain levers in both deal and non-deal environments. The team works across pillars of Plan, Source, Make and Deliver in the context of transactions and as standalone transformation initiatives. The opportunity EY-Parthenon s GDS SCM practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions and supply chain transformations. We are a group of experienced strategy and transaction professionals with a background in supply chain and operations who work across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. As such, we bring a wealth of deep supply chain functional knowledge to our clients in the context of complex transactions and transformations. This is an opportunity to work across the entire transaction lifecycle (pre-sign diligence, sign-to-close planning, post-close execution, etc.) of the most complex integrations (M&A) and divestitures. Moreover, you ll have the opportunity to help our clients solve complex supply chain problems, developing innovative solutions that transform the supply chain, improving performance and resiliency across the plan, source, make, deliver/return functions of the supply chain. We re looking for a Manager, who supports key outcomes and executes complex supply chain engagements. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a fast growing service offering in Strategy and Transactions. Your key responsibilities Manage and oversee engagements that help our clients solve some of their most pressing supply chain issues. Support key decision makers in developing and executing their transaction strategy to secure deal value. Lead projects that span one or more supply chain pillars (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver) in both deal and non-deal environments. Manage engagements, problem-solve, facilitate, ensure engagement success, and quality in delivery Build relationships with EY offices across the globe. Responsible for high degree of GDS user satisfaction with engagement processes and work products Engage on larger SaT projects and pitch for potential supply chain interventions. Ability to analyse the evolving market environment and build solutions / services to cater to the same. Develop Point of View documents and support business development initiatives Manage a team of supply chain consultants. Help the team members develop expertise on all SCM pillars. Mentor junior team members to deliver on high quality output on engagements Provide insights/observations based on industry/functional knowledge and best practices that span Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver. Leverage expertise in transactions, synergy assessments, and deal implementation on transactions related projects Skills and attributes for success Business and Commercially Driven - work in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients Capability Development - contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work Learning - learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences Building Relationships - cultivate strong working relationships with clients and support to key decision makers 
 To qualify for the role, you must have Post Graduate degree in business management from a premier institute with 8-12 years of applicable consulting and / or industry experience At least 3 years of management consulting experience across at least two SCM pillars (Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver) in a top tier consulting firm An understanding of the transaction life cycle, and carve-out / integration of a business post-announcement of transaction Experience in running cost transformation program across direct and indirect categories An understand of Design to value especially teardown led competitive benchmarking and value engineering tailored for Direct Materials Experience leading and managing in complex business environments Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g. Alteryx, Python, Power BI, SQL) and expertise in applying analytics to solve supply chain problems/issues Excellent problem solving, project management, facilitation and interpersonal skills Willingness to undertake international travel as per business requirements Strong communication and presentation skills Ideally, you ll also have Experience with the implementation of Lean Six Sigma projects, and statistical tools Experience with working on transactions and in buy and integrate, or sell and separate scenarios What you can look for A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3,500+ professionals Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries What we offer 
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning : You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture : You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world 
 
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 
 
 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 
 
 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Location: Factory Unit - Shivare , Near Khed Shivapur toll plaza, Pune, Maharashtra 
 Immediate Joiners will be preferred 
 Full-Time | On-Site 
 At Basillia Organics Pvt Ltd, we are transforming the future of food with our regenerative, climate-smart, and organic product lines under the brand Gudmom. We are looking for a Sr Quality Executive who can lead our manufacturing and packaging operations quality with excellence in productivity, quality, safety, compliance, and technology integration Knowledge of Quality & Food safety management systems.  Roles & Responsibilities 1. In-Process & Line Quality Control Oversee daily shift quality operations across grain cleaning, sorting, grading, packaging units. Monitor physical parameters of products (moisture levels, broken percentages, impurities and other). Enforce Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP) on the factory floor. Define and strictly implement clean-out protocols between production batches to completely avoid batch cross-contamination. 2. Organic Compliance & Certifications Maintain meticulous documentation required for NPOP (India) , USDA Organic , BRCGS and EU Organic regulations. Manage end-to-end batch traceability records. Coordinate the verification, storage, and issuance of Transaction Certificates (TCs) for both domestic movements and global exports. Ensure full compliance with FSSAI and Jaivik Bharat packaging and labeling regulations. 3. Auditing & Vendor Compliance Act as the primary point of contact for external validation audits by third-party certification bodies. Lead routine internal audits of the processing plant using Internal Control System (ICS) guidelines. Track quality deviations; formulate robust Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports and drive the implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) . 4. Lab Testing & Batch Clearance Supervise basic physical, chemical, and microbiological sampling of raw procurement and finished goods. Coordinate external lab testing schedules for mandatory pesticide residue screening, heavy metals testing, and shelf-life verification. Experience : 4 - 8 years of experience in managing food / FMCG / agri / organic processing / export units Standards Expertise: Proven execution experience with HACCP, ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, BRCGS standards. Software Skills: Familiarity with managing inventory quality codes or batch traceability through an ERP or specialized food supply chain software. Core Competencies: Strong analytical mindset, audit documentation rigor, capability to resolve plant-floor quality non-conformities swiftly, and comfortable working in a manufacturing unit setup. Based in or willing to relocate to Pune (Factory location: Shivare, Near Khed Shivapur, Pune)

title: Sr. Manager - Marketplaces
description:
Crocs India is looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketplace Business Lead to take ownership of topline delivery and day-to-day commercial performance of our marketplace business across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Nykaa, Tata Cliq and other relevant platforms. This is a 912 month fixed-term role requiring someone who can quickly understand the business, lead the existing team and independently drive commercial performance against the agreed plan. The role will own delivery of the marketplace operating plan (revenue, margin and EBIT), platform relationships and execution, within the strategy and commercial guardrails set by the Senior Director, while partnering closely with merchandising, marketing, supply chain and finance. We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking the lead without waiting for detailed direction, making sound decisions and owning outcomes through to closure. Please note this role is a 12 months fixed term contract. 
 Role & responsibilities Business & Performance Ownership Own delivery of the agreed marketplace plan including revenue, margin, EBIT, sell-through, inventory, returns and platform visibility. Drive weekly and monthly trading performance and take timely corrective actions against business gaps. Balance growth, profitability, inventory health and brand objectives within agreed commercial guardrails, escalating material trade-offs. Communicate business performance, forecasts, risks and required interventions clearly to the Senior Director and leadership. Identify and activate incremental growth opportunities across assortment, availability, visibility, conversion and platform events. Maintain business continuity through the assignment and document key plans, trading rhythms and decisions to enable a smooth handover. Team Leadership Lead and support the existing team of Key Account Managers and establish clear priorities, accountability and execution discipline. Create a culture of ownership, agility and problem-solving. Provide stability and clear direction to the team during the transition period. Platform & Partner Management Own relationships with key marketplace partners and manage commercial plans, platform events, assortment, visibility and marketing opportunities. Negotiate effectively with platforms within agreed commercial parameters while protecting commercial and brand objectives. Cross-functional Execution Partner with merchandising, marketing, supply chain, finance and content teams to deliver marketplace priorities. Proactively resolve cross-functional issues and drive them through to closure. Insights & Problem Solving Use marketplace and consumer data to identify opportunities and performance gaps. Take the first lead on issues, bring the right stakeholders together and own resolution rather than waiting for direction, escalating decisions that materially change strategy, investment or long-term commitments. 
 Preferred candidate profile 10+ years of experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, digital commerce or key account management. Strong hands-on experience managing major Indian marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra. Demonstrated P&L and commercial ownership. Proven ability to lead and manage teams. Strong commercial judgment, analytical capability and negotiation skills. Ability to operate independently and thrive in ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mindset with a bias for action and willingness to take the lead. Ability to step in quickly with limited ramp-up time and establish credibility with the team, platform partners and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience in fashion, footwear, lifestyle or other consumer categories preferred, but not mandatory. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. MBA/postgraduate qualification is preferred, but not mandatory.

title: LAB Procurement Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Lab Procurement Manager responsible for managing end-to-end procurement of laboratory machinery, scientific equipment, fermenters, and other laboratory-related materials. The candidate should have strong experience in sourcing specialized laboratory equipment, identifying reliable vendors, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring timely procurement of quality equipment as per organizational requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end procurement of laboratory machinery, scientific instruments, equipment, and laboratory consumables. Handle procurement of fermenters, bioreactors, and fermentation-related equipment . Source and procure specialized laboratory equipment such as:
 Fermenters and bioreactors Laboratory reactors and incubators Autoclaves and sterilization equipment Centrifuges and laboratory mixers Analytical instruments and testing equipment Laboratory glassware, chemicals, and consumables Other R&D and laboratory infrastructure requirements. Identify, evaluate, and develop a strong vendor base for domestic and international laboratory equipment suppliers. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and after-sales service agreements. Coordinate with R&D, Quality Control, Production, and Laboratory teams to understand technical procurement requirements. Ensure equipment specifications, quality standards, and technical requirements are met before procurement. Manage vendor performance, equipment installation, commissioning, and maintenance coordination. Monitor procurement budgets and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality. Ensure timely delivery of equipment and materials to avoid delays in laboratory operations and research activities. Maintain procurement documentation, purchase orders, vendor records, and inventory tracking. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in procurement of laboratory machinery, scientific equipment, and specialized lab instruments. Hands-on experience in sourcing and purchasing fermenters, bioreactors, and fermentation equipment . Knowledge of laboratory setup, R&D infrastructure, and biotechnology-related equipment. Experience in vendor development, price negotiation, and strategic sourcing. Understanding of technical specifications, equipment quality standards, and supplier evaluation. Experience in domestic and international procurement will be an added advantage. Strong coordination and communication skills with technical and R&D teams. Good negotiation, analytical, and cost-management skills. Desired Candidate Profile Candidates with experience in Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, Chemicals, Agriculture, or related industries. Prior experience handling procurement for R&D laboratories, biotechnology labs, or fermentation facilities will be highly preferred. Should have the ability to independently manage specialized laboratory procurement requirements from vendor identification to final installation. Key Requirement: Candidates must have practical experience in procurement of laboratory machinery and equipment, particularly fermenters and bioreactors. title: SEO Copywriter (Sr. Executive)
description:
ABOUT TIDE At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 
 Tide facts: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs Over 2 million members across UK and India Over $300 million raised in funding Over 2,800 Tideans globally Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among Indias Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026 We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a highly skilled and data-driven Copywriter SEO & ASO to lead our organic growth efforts across web and mobile. The ideal candidate will own end-to-end SEO and ASO strategy to drive high-intent organic acquisition for our MSME-focused financial products including Fixed Deposits, Insurance/Assurance, Lending, Prepaid Cards, and business banking solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities:  Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Build, own, and execute organic acquisition strategy to drive high-quality traffic and conversions from MSME merchants and financial product seekers. Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis across MSME, lending, FD, assurance, and prepaid card segments. Optimize website architecture, internal linking, product landing pages, blogs, and performance pages to improve rankings & search visibility. Lead technical SEO improvements: crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, site speed, structured data/schema. Build content strategy with product & content teamsblog articles, product guides, comparison pages, FAQ hubs, UGC, etc. Track organic funnel performance and optimize for sign-ups, applications, and revenue impact. Manage agency relationships, freelancers, and internal resources. 
 App Store Optimization (ASO) Own the growth of organic app installs for Android & iOS. Optimize metadata: titles, descriptions, screenshots, preview videos, and localized content. Research and implement keyword expansion, competitor benchmarking, and A/B testing strategies. Improve app rating, reviews management, and conversion from store listing views to installs. Partner with product teams to align features and releases with store optimization opportunities. 
 Analytics & Performance Analyze data using GA4, Search Console, App Radar/Sensor Tower, AppFollow, SEMRush, Ahrefs, SimilarWeb, and other tools. Define KPIs and report on organic install growth, ranking improvements, conversion impact, and business outcomes. Build forecasting models for organic acquisition ROI & revenue contribution. Collaborate with performance marketing to reduce CAC via organic uplift. 
 Qualifications & Skills 3+ years of hands-on experience in SEO & ASO, ideally in Fintech or BFSI. Proven track record of scaling organic acquisition and driving measurable business impact. Strong expertise in keyword planning, technical SEO, link-building strategies, and app store analytics. Comfort with tools like GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, SEMRush, App Radar, AppTweak, Firebase, Data Studio, Hotjar, etc. Good understanding of MSME user behavior, digital lending ecosystem, RBI compliance environment, and financial product search trends. Strong analytical & stakeholder communication skills; ability to convert insights into action. 
 What You'll Bring Growth mindset with ownership attitude. Ability to work cross-functionally with product, tech, and performance teams. Passion for solving customer problems and building trust-first financial products. 
 Key Performance Indicators Organic traffic & ranking improvements. Growth in organic registrations / applications / revenue. Increase in app store conversion rate & keyword rankings. Reduction in dependency on paid acquisition & CAC improvement. 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Experience in a content role, ideally 3+ years. You are knowledgeable and passionate about content, conversion & SEO. You are self-assured, driven, able to make decisions and take responsibility for them as well as great teamwork skills. You are able to communicate with different audiences, internally and externally. You have excellent communication and copywriting skills. You have a strong grasp of English grammar, structure and punctuation. You have an eye for detail, as well as excellent proofreading and editing skills. You are able to adapt your writing style to fit Tides tone of voice. You are familiar with industry trends and competition, identify strategic opportunities. You have excellent planning, organisational and time management skills. You are adaptable and able to grow with the role, working with different people whilst being flexible. You may also have experience in Fin-tech, a start-up or fast growing company. You may also have experience working in subscription and/or app-based business models. 
 WHAT YOULL GET IN RETURN Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: Competitive Compensation Competitive salary. Time Off Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. Parental Leave Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. Sabbatical Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office. Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement. Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 
 TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.  We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Please be aware that: Tide does  not  charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our  Careers Page  and applications should be submitted through this channel. title: SAP Functional Consultant
description:
Position Title : SAP ISU Billing & FICA Consultant (Functional) 
 
 Work Location : PAN India, Wipro Offices 
 
 : 
 
 We are seeking an experienced SAP ISU Billing & FICA Consultant to manage and support the implementation of SAP ISU solutions for utilities. The role requires in-depth knowledge of the ISU (Industry-Specific Solution for Utilities) module, specifically around Billing, Invoicing, and FICA (Contract Accounting). The ideal candidate should be proficient in configuration, integration, and solution design to meet business needs. 
 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 
 1. SAP ISU Billing : 
 
 - Configure and implement SAP ISU Billing components for Meter-to-Cash processes, including rate structures, billing types, and invoicing scenarios. 
 
 - Design and execute billing processes such as meter reading, billing simulations, billing reversals, and billing-related issue resolution. 
 
 - Manage the billing master data including rate categories, contracts, and price determination. 
 
 - Work on billing-relevant enhancements, validations, and customizations as per client requirements. 
 
 2. SAP FICA (Contract Accounting) : 
 
 - Configure FICA components such as Payment Processing, Dunning, Collections, Installment Plans, and Clearing Control. 
 
 - Handle FICA sub-ledger processes including Receivables Management, Account Posting, Interest Calculation, and Tax Handling. 
 
 - Set up payment schemes and integration with external payment platforms. 
 
 - Implement reconciliation between ISU and FI (Finance) modules for contract accounting and ensure accurate reporting. 
 
 3. Integration & Process Improvement : 
 
 - Collaborate with other functional teams (e.g., SD, FI, MM) to ensure seamless integration across business processes. 
 
 - Drive improvements and optimization of business processes related to billing and financial accounting. 
 
 - Provide end-to-end functional support for SAP ISU implementations, ensuring integration with non-SAP systems where necessary. 
 
 - Understand business process requirements and map them to SAP functionality for utilities billing and financial operations. 
 
 4. Testing & Documentation : 
 
 - Create and execute unit tests, integration tests, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for SAP ISU Billing and FICA processes. 
 
 - Document functional designs, test cases, and configurations to maintain project and system documentation standards. 
 
 - Provide post-go-live support for billing and contract accounting issues, ensuring that they are resolved in a timely manner. 
 
 5. Training & Support : 
 
 - Train end-users and client stakeholders on SAP ISU billing processes, functionalities, and best practices. 
 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues encountered in day-to-day operations related to billing and FICA. 
 
 - Support the client in cutover activities, data migration, and transition to new billing processes. 
 
 Required Skills : 
 
 - 5+ years of experience working with SAP ISU, specializing in Billing and FICA modules. 
 
 - Expertise in SAP ISU Billing configuration including billing cycles, rate determination, invoicing, and integration with SAP FI/CO. 
 
 - Strong understanding of Contract Accounting (FICA), including payment processing, dunning, collections, and reconciliation processes. 
 
 - Experience with data migration, interfaces, and integration with external systems for meter readings, payment systems, and billing data. 
 
 - Familiarity with utilities industry-specific processes, business rules, and regulatory requirements. 
 
 - Proficient in configuring billing schema, rates, price determination, and FICA processes like dunning and settlements. 
 
 Preferred Skills : 
 
 - Experience with SAP S/4HANA for Utilities. 
 
 - Knowledge of FICA enhancements for complex business processes in the utilities domain. 
 
 - Hands-on experience in ABAP debugging related to billing and FICA functions is a plus. 
 
 - Familiarity with BRF+ (Business Rule Framework Plus) for rule-based billing and invoicing. 
 
 - SAP certification in ISU or FICA is preferred. 
 
 Educational Requirements : 
 
 - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Finance, or Engineering. 
 
 - SAP certifications in ISU Billing, FICA, or related fields are an advantage.

title: Plant Head
description:
Role Overview The Plant Head will lead the Bangalore manufacturing facility and oversee associated operations in Hyderabad (assembly unit) and Mumbai (warehouse). This role demands a highly technical leader who can build, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize machinery and production systemsensuring the plant scales efficiently.   The ideal candidate brings strong handson engineering capability, deep understanding of cold chain packaging processes, and the ability to drive operational excellence while doubling output with the existing workforce.   Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence Provide strong technical direction across the plant, ensuring inhouse capability for machine building, integration, and troubleshooting. Lead decisions on machinery such as hotwire cutting machines, bridge filling machines, EPS/PU/PV/PS cutting and gluing systems, and manual assembly lines. Reduce dependency on external vendors by developing internal technical competence. Oversee preventive and breakdown maintenance, ensuring minimal downtime and high equipment reliability.   2. Plant Operations Management Lead endtoend operations of the Bangalore plant, including assembling, quality, maintenance, logistics, and administration. Manage the shop floor, ensuring adherence to quality, safety, and compliance standards. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance throughput, efficiency, and cost optimization.   3. MultiSite Oversight Supervise the Hyderabad and Mumbai assembly and warehouse operations. Ensure alignment of processes, inventory accuracy, and operational discipline across all locations.   4. People Leadership Lead crossfunctional teams including production, quality, logistics, admin, and sales support. Mentor and upskill teams to strengthen technical capability and operational maturity. Collaborate with the existing operations manager while providing the technical backbone for the plant.   5. Business & Performance Management Own key operational metrics including production output, quality performance, cost efficiency, and inventory management. Drive the strategic goal of doubling turnover with the same headcount through process optimization and technical innovation. Support financial planning, budgeting, and cost control initiatives. Coordinate with sales teams to ensure production readiness and timely order fulfillment.   Required Skills & Competencies Technical Expertise Strong handson experience with EPS/PU/PV/PS cutting, gluing, molding, and assembly operations. Ability to build, modify, and integrate machines and production lines. Deep understanding of cold chain packaging components such as cardboard structures, EPS/PU insulation, and gel packs.   Operational Excellence Proven experience managing manufacturing plants with multidisciplinary teams. Strong knowledge of production planning, quality systems, inventory control, and logistics. Experience scaling operations and improving throughput without increasing manpower.   Preferred Background 10–12+ years of experience in manufacturing, preferably in: Cold chain packaging EPS/PU/PV/PS manufacturing Paper/packaging industries Thermal insulation products Mechanical, industrial, or production engineering background preferred.
